title: HPE to Acquire Zerto, a Cloud Data Management and Protection Company, Bolstering GreenLake Storage Portfolio
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) announced its acquisition of Zerto, a cloud data management and protection company, for $374 million. This acquisition is set to enhance HPE's GreenLake portfolio, specifically strengthening its cloud-native, software-defined storage services. Zerto's continuous data protection technology for disaster recovery and ransomware protection across hybrid and multi-cloud environments will significantly contribute to HPE's offerings and competitiveness in the rapidly growing data protection as a service market.

title: AvePoint (Nasdaq:AVPT) - Stock Analysis
summary: This Simply Wall St analysis provides an overview of AvePoint (AVPT), a cloud-native data management software platform. It highlights that the stock is currently undervalued, with strong forecasted earnings growth but also notes risks like insider selling and past shareholder dilution. The report details AvePoint's financial health, growth prospects, and recent news, positioning it as an essential provider for enterprise data governance.

title: Amazon stock nabs record after Bezos-Jassy handoff
summary: Amazon's stock reached an all-time high of $3,675.74 after Andy Jassy officially took over as CEO from Jeff Bezos. Investors appear confident in Jassy, who previously ran Amazon Web Services, as the company nears a $2 trillion market capitalization, aiming to join Apple and Microsoft. Jassy also received a substantial incentive package of 61,000 shares, valued at over $214 million, vesting over 10 years.

title: 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM (Security Information and Event Management)
summary: Solutions Review provides an analysis of the 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM, highlighting key changes from previous reports and the evolving landscape of the SIEM market. The report includes 20 vendors, noting new additions and exclusions, and discusses the clustering of vendors towards the center of the quadrant, suggesting growing universality of capabilities. It details the positions of various vendors in the Niche Players, Visionaries, and Leaders quadrants, along with their respective strengths.

title: LG swings battle for premium TV supremacy
summary: The COVID-19 pandemic has accelerated demand for premium TVs, with OLED TV shipments increasing significantly. LG Electronics has seen its share of the premium TV market rise to 28% by Q1, while Samsung's share declined. LG Display's OLED technology is driving this shift, with confidence in OLED's image quality, eye health benefits, and environmental advantages leading to continued market growth and diversification among TV manufacturers.

title: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Touted in Netgear Router Flaw Discovery
summary: Microsoft's Defender for Endpoint played a crucial role in discovering a side-channel attack vulnerability in Netgear DGN-2200v1 wireless home DSL routers. This flaw could allow attackers to bypass authentication and compromise network security. Microsoft used this discovery to highlight the importance of endpoint discovery solutions and its enhanced capabilities in detecting firmware flaws, especially after acquiring ReFirm Labs.

title: Trump sues Facebook, Twitter and Google over social media bans
summary: Former US President Donald Trump has filed class-action lawsuits against Facebook, Twitter, and Google, as well as their chief executives, aiming to overturn his social media bans and seek punitive damages. Trump argues that these tech giants, by banning him, are violating First Amendment rights and should be considered government actors due to their liability protections under Section 230. The lawsuits follow his permanent ban from Twitter and a two-year suspension from Facebook after the January 6 Capitol riot, reigniting debates about Section 230 and social media censorship of conservative viewpoints.

title: SOC Prime Mentioned as a Detection Content Provider in the 2021 Gartner, SIEM Magic Quadrant
summary: SOC Prime, a leader in Detection as Code, has been recognized for the second consecutive year in the 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Security Information and Event Management (SIEM). The company's platform helps organizations improve SIEM and EDR detection capabilities, supporting 9 SIEM vendors identified in the Gartner report. This recognition also highlights the growth of the Sigma project, a de-facto standard for threat detection queries.

title: Apple May Join Forces with LG to Keep Samsung in Check
summary: Apple and LG Group are reportedly partnering to counter Samsung Electronics' dominance in the global market. Apple is leveraging LG Electronics' exit from the mobile business by offering trade-in programs for LG smartphone users in North America and Korea. Additionally, LG is exploring new business ventures with Apple, including selling Apple products in LG Best Shops and potentially collaborating on the Apple Car project through LG Magna e-Powertrain.

title: Oracle CEO Safra Catz underscores Israel support in Jerusalem data center launch
summary: Oracle CEO Safra Catz emphasized Oracle's strong support for Israel during the launch of a new data center in Jerusalem, despite the company losing a major cloud project tender to AWS and Google. Catz, an Israeli-born executive, stated that Oracle's commitment to Israel is unwavering and that employees who disagree with this mission might not be a fit for the company. She also expressed confusion regarding Oracle not being selected for Israel's $1 billion "Nimbus" cloud project.

title: How to Translate Your Website Into Other Languages and Why It’s Important
summary: This article emphasizes the importance of translating websites for software providers expanding into new international markets, noting that nearly 66% of buyers prefer content in their primary language. It discusses how advancements in AI and neural machine translation have improved the speed and quality of website translation, shifting the translator's role more toward editing. The piece also outlines various translation services and stresses the need for thorough editorial review to ensure cultural appropriateness and accuracy before a translated website goes live.

title: NERC, FERC highlight need for continued vigilance around supply chain compromises
summary: The North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) and the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) released a joint white paper emphasizing the ongoing need for vigilance against supply chain compromises affecting the North American electricity industry. The paper, focusing on incidents like SolarWinds, Microsoft 365/Azure, and Pulse Connect Secure vulnerabilities, recommends specific cybersecurity mitigation actions, including revalidating least-privilege principles, implementing NIST Cybersecurity Framework guidelines, and enhancing voluntary reporting. They stress that the electricity industry must continually adapt to new information and threats, as supply chain attacks are difficult to prevent and will continue to occur.

title: Connected car company Xevo, owned by Lear, hit with layoffs in Seattle area
summary: Xevo, a Bellevue, Wash.-based connected-car software company owned by global automotive giant Lear, has laid off 97 workers. The company, which develops software for automakers like Toyota and GMC, previously rebranded from UIEvolution in 2016. Lear, Xevo's parent company, reported strong sales and net income in its most recent quarter.

title: The startup helping P&G, Mercedes-Benz replace petrochemicals
summary: Twelve, a carbon transformation company formerly known as Opus 12, has secured $57 million in Series A funding to scale its electrolysis technology. This technology converts industrial CO2 emissions into ingredients for various products, aiming to replace petrochemicals in items from sneakers to detergents, and is already being used by P&G and Mercedes-Benz. The company plans to use the new capital to transition its systems from pilot size to industrial scale, offering a solution for businesses to achieve climate goals while maintaining product performance.

title: "Stratospheric" tech company valuations outstrip US GDP
summary: New research indicates that tech company valuations have reached over $35 trillion, surpassing the entire US GDP of $20.81 trillion in 2020. This boom is fueled by substantial investor interest, with over $40 billion invested in tech vendors in the first half of 2021 alone, and more than two "unicorns" (billion-dollar tech firms) being created daily. The tech sector is seen as a resilient and safe investment, especially post-Covid-19, intensified by global government support and central bank liquidity.

title: CIBC Announces Multi-Year Agreement to Use Microsoft’s Cloud-Based Platform
summary: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC) has entered into a multi-year strategic agreement with Microsoft Corp. to utilize Microsoft Azure as its primary cloud platform, accelerating its digital transformation. This investment aims to enhance client-facing services, foster innovation in AI and machine learning, and strengthen data protection and security. CIBC will also gain access to Microsoft's training and certification programs to develop its talent.

title: JPMorgan U.S. Research Enhanced Large Cap ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (NYSEARCA:JUSA)
summary: The JPMorgan U.S. Research Enhanced Large Cap ETF (JUSA) is an actively managed ETF focusing on large-cap US equities, launched on July 7, 2021, and managed by JPMorgan Chase. The ETF has seen a 7.6% increase in its stock price since the beginning of the year and currently has $204.68 million in assets under management. Its top holdings include major technology companies like NVIDIA, Apple, Microsoft, and Amazon.com.

title: What’s Changed: 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant for the CRM Customer Engagement Center
summary: This article reviews the 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant for the CRM Customer Engagement Center, highlighting what has changed since the previous iteration. It details Gartner's definition of the CEC market and evaluates 16 significant providers based on their "Completeness of Vision" and "Ability to Execute." The report categorizes vendors into Leaders, Challengers, Niche Players, and Visionaries, providing a breakdown of each company's strengths within their respective quadrants.

title: China blocks Tencent’s US$5.3b merger of gaming giants Huya and Douyu
summary: China's antitrust regulator blocked Tencent's US$5.3 billion merger of gaming streamers Huya and Douyu, citing concerns about strengthened market dominance and restricted competition. Tencent already holds significant stakes in both companies and has a large share of the online game operations market in China. This decision marks a significant move by Chinese regulators to intensify scrutiny of monopolistic behavior in the country's tech sector.

title: How Microsoft has kept Windows on top for two decades
summary: Microsoft Windows has maintained its dominant position in the PC operating system market for over two decades, holding an 83% market share. Despite some poorly received versions and missing the smartphone wave, Windows continues to grow, partly due to its familiarity for enterprises and free upgrades. With the upcoming Windows 11, Microsoft aims to refresh the system and potentially boost PC sales.

title: Microsoft acquires digital threat management firm RiskIQ for $500M
summary: Microsoft has acquired RiskIQ, a digital threat management firm, for $500 million to enhance its security offerings. RiskIQ specializes in mapping and securing an organization's externally accessible infrastructure, providing valuable threat intelligence. This acquisition allows Microsoft to integrate RiskIQ's technology into its Azure cloud services and reinforces its ongoing efforts to strengthen its cybersecurity product portfolio.

title: Broadcom in talks to buy software firm SAS
summary: Broadcom Inc. is reportedly in talks to acquire SAS Institute Inc., a privately held software firm, for an estimated $15 billion to $20 billion. This potential deal aligns with Broadcom's strategy to expand its enterprise software business, following previous acquisitions like CA Technologies and Symantec's enterprise unit. The move also comes amidst increased scrutiny on large tech mergers from the Biden administration.

title: CIBC formalizes Microsoft Azure as its primary cloud platform
summary: CIBC has formalized Microsoft Azure as its primary cloud platform through a multi-year agreement, enabling the Canadian bank to scale and modernize its banking platforms, improve resiliency, efficiency, and agility. This strategic relationship will support faster, real-time, data-driven decisions and enhance client experience by accelerating application migration to the cloud, powering AI/ML platforms, and providing a secure foundation leveraging Microsoft's global footprint and Canadian data centres. The collaboration builds on previous successful work between CIBC and Microsoft, including the use of Office 365.

title: HyperX Welcomes TimTheTatman as Global Brand Ambassador
summary: HyperX, the gaming peripherals team at HP Inc., announced popular Twitch streamer Tim “TimTheTatman” Betar as its newest global brand ambassador. With nearly seven million followers, Betar will participate in HyperX marketing activities, including virtual streams and original content creation for his "tatmanarmy." He joins a roster of international talent and will receive a custom "HyperX Hero" illustration.

title: Microsoft acquired RiskIQ to strengthen cybersecurity of digital transformation and hybrid work
summary: Microsoft has acquired RiskIQ, a leader in global threat intelligence and attack surface management, to enhance the cybersecurity offerings for customers undergoing digital transformation and embracing hybrid work. This acquisition aims to provide customers with a more comprehensive view of global threats, better understand vulnerable internet-facing assets, and build world-class threat intelligence. RiskIQ's expertise in discovering and assessing enterprise attack surfaces across various cloud environments and on-premises will bolster Microsoft's existing security portfolio.

title: XYLG Stock Price | Global X S&P 500 Covered Call & Growth ETF
summary: This page provides detailed information about the Global X S&P 500 Covered Call & Growth ETF (XYLG), including its current stock price, trading exchange (NYSE), and key statistics like dividend yield, expense ratio, and market cap. It also offers insights into its performance, top holdings, and technical analysis, making it a comprehensive resource for potential investors.

title: REPORTS: Microsoft to spend more than $200 million on data centers in San Antonio
summary: Microsoft is expanding its presence in San Antonio with plans to spend over $200 million on new data centers. The company has multiple data center buildings under construction or scheduled to begin soon, totaling millions of square feet and expected to be completed between 2022 and 2024. These developments are located in the Texas Research Park and on Wiseman Blvd.

title: Intercontinental Exchange modernizes documentation for the global market
summary: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) has adopted Adobe Acrobat Sign to streamline its global operations, enhancing efficiency and security for various departments including sales, operations, legal, and HR. The switch from their previous e-signature vendor was driven by competitive cost, high security, and faster onboarding, with key integrations with platforms like Salesforce and Microsoft SharePoint. This transition has significantly reduced paper processes and accelerated document processing, with contracts being completed in minutes, even with global clients.

title: How VR and AR Can Help You Better Visualize Projects
summary: This article explores how Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR) technologies are transforming product visualization for designers, engineers, and clients. It differentiates between VR's immersive 3D environments and AR's superimposed graphics, detailing their real-world applications beyond gaming, such as in product design, education, and simulation. The piece emphasizes the benefits of these technologies in improving the design and review process by allowing interactive previews of products in their intended spaces.

title: BIPOC and women employees ranked their CEOs: These were the top 10 for 2021
summary: A new Comparably survey reveals the top CEOs as ranked by their BIPOC and women employees in 2021, based on 10 million anonymous ratings. Eric Yuan of Zoom Video Communications topped the list for BIPOC employees, while Shantanu Narayen of Adobe ranked highest among women. The rankings also highlight a significant shift compared to previous years and note the limited presence of female CEOs at the very top.

title: United Airlines is buying 100 new electric planes
summary: United Airlines is investing in electric aircraft startup Heart Aerospace and plans to purchase up to 100 ES-19 electric planes. These 19-seat aircraft are intended for short flights up to 250 miles, with service expected to begin by 2026. This move is part of United's goal to reduce its greenhouse gas emissions by 100 percent by 2050.

title: RMI and Microsoft Show How Corporations Can Accelerate a Cleaner Grid
summary: RMI and Microsoft collaborated on a white paper assessing hourly clean energy procurement strategies. The study, "Clean Power by the Hour," finds that while these strategies can lay the groundwork for a decarbonized grid, their effectiveness in near-term emissions reductions depends heavily on regional grid dynamics. The report recommends tailoring strategies to grid specifics, expanding wholesale market access, and balancing procurement goals with the imperative for rapid emissions reduction to maximize impact.

title: Microsoft and NEC expand strategic partnership to boost business resiliency and growth
summary: Microsoft and NEC announced an expanded strategic partnership to accelerate cloud adoption and digital transformation for enterprise and public sector customers. This collaboration will leverage Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365, NEC's network and IT expertise including 5G, and both companies' AI and IoT solutions. NEC will also adopt Microsoft Azure as its preferred cloud platform and migrate its internal IT environment, aiming to double the number of digital-focused engineers skilled in Microsoft technologies within the NEC Group.

title: SolidFire flickering out: Dave Wright exits NetApp for fintech
summary: SolidFire founder Dave Wright has left NetApp to become CEO of the fintech company The Reserve Trust Company (TRTC), based in Denver. NetApp acquired SolidFire in 2016 for $870 million, but the SolidFire technology has been largely overshadowed by NetApp's ONTAP platform. TRTC provides payment services to financial institutions and other fintechs and is backed by investors including QED and Temerity Capital Partners.

title: What’s fuelling growth in the Global X Autonomous & Electric Vehicles ETF?
summary: The Global X Autonomous & Electric Vehicles ETF (DRIV) has shown significant growth, fueled by increasing demand for electric and autonomous vehicles and government initiatives supporting green energy. Top holdings include Nvidia, Alphabet, Microsoft, Apple, and Toyota, reflecting investment in both hardware and software for this disruptive technology. Despite potential challenges like volatility and supply chain issues, analysts believe the ETF offers diversified exposure to the booming EV sector.

title: Teladoc Health and Microsoft Collaborate to Create a Unified Practice Experience for Clinicians
summary: Teladoc Health and Microsoft have partnered to integrate Teladoc Health’s Solo platform with Microsoft Teams, aiming to streamline virtual healthcare operations for clinicians and health systems. This collaboration will improve communication and workflow efficiency, allowing healthcare providers to deliver high-quality virtual care without leaving the Teams environment. The initiative seeks to unify clinical and administrative tasks, leveraging both companies' expertise in data and AI to enhance patient care and system efficiency.

title: Spotify’s Top Lawyer Has Spent Years Making Apple the Bad Guy
summary: Horacio Gutierrez, Spotify’s chief legal officer, has been a key figure in the ongoing antitrust battle against Apple. Having previously defended Microsoft in an antitrust case, Gutierrez has now switched sides and led Spotify's campaign, aiming to portray Apple as an abusive monopolist. His efforts have contributed to a significant shift in public perception regarding Apple's business practices, making it a target for antitrust scrutiny alongside other tech giants.

title: From collaborative apps in Microsoft Teams to Windows 365—here’s what’s new in Microsoft 365 at Inspire
summary: Microsoft unveiled significant updates to Microsoft 365 at Inspire, focusing on enhancing hybrid work experiences. Key announcements include new collaborative apps within Microsoft Teams, integrations between Dynamics 365 and Teams without additional licensing costs, and the introduction of Windows 365 Cloud PC for a personalized Windows experience from any device. The company also expanded Microsoft Viva with new partner integrations and development tools, alongside new security features like Microsoft 365 Lighthouse to help manage security postures for small and medium businesses.

title: A complete guide to Amazon stock
summary: This article provides a comprehensive guide to Amazon stock, discussing its performance, market position, and how investors can trade it. It highlights Amazon's primary revenue streams (retail, subscriptions, and AWS), the company's valuation, and key factors investors should consider before trading AMZN shares, such as its growth-over-profit strategy and the importance of AWS.

title: How Sonoco used Oracle Cloud as part of its multicloud tech transformation
summary: Sonoco, a packaging company, embarked on a multicloud strategy to modernize its IT infrastructure, moving legacy applications from on-premises data centers to the cloud. The company leveraged Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) for its Oracle databases and applications, taking advantage of the Oracle-Microsoft interconnect for seamless integration with Azure. This transition allowed Sonoco to build purpose-built cloud environments, scale resources efficiently, and enhance disaster recovery and security for its operations.

title: Teladoc Health Integrates Solo platform with Microsoft Teams for Health Systems
summary: Teladoc Health has announced a collaboration with Microsoft to integrate its Solo platform for hospitals and health systems into the Microsoft Teams environment. This integration aims to enhance physician and patient access to virtual healthcare by streamlining communication and workflows. Clinicians will be able to securely access EHR data directly within the Teams environment, simplifying the delivery of virtual care.

title: Markforged begins trading on New York Stock Exchange
summary: Markforged has commenced trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol ‘MKFG’ after merging with one, a special purpose acquisition company. The company received approximately $361 million in gross proceeds from the merger, including a $210 million PIPE. Markforged plans to use this capital to accelerate product innovation, customer adoption, and capitalize on the growing trends in additive manufacturing.

title: Microsoft (MSFT) Acquires RiskIQ to Strengthen Security Business
summary: Microsoft Corporation has acquired cybersecurity firm RiskIQ for an undisclosed amount, reportedly around $500 million. This acquisition aims to boost Microsoft's security business, which generated $10 billion in revenue earlier this year, by enhancing its cloud security offerings and protecting its applications from cyber threats. RiskIQ specializes in monitoring operations and security across cloud applications, and its integration will strengthen Microsoft's Azure cloud solution and overall security portfolio.

title: Los Angeles Daily News - First Trust Nasdaq Cybersecurity ETF is now Available for Sale in Mexican Pension Plans.
summary: First Trust, a global ETF provider, announced that its Nasdaq Cybersecurity ETF (CIBR) has been approved by the Mexican pension funds investment regulator, CONSAR, for sale to Mexican funded pensions (AFORES). This approval means that CIBR, recognized as the world's largest cybersecurity ETF, can now be purchased within Mexican pension funds, expanding thematic investment opportunities for institutional investors in the region. The article also provides detailed risk disclosures for investing in the fund, including market volatility, non-diversification, and risks associated with cybersecurity companies and international investments.

title: Global software company to acquire SAS, say insiders
summary: Broadcom Inc., an American semiconductor manufacturing company, is reportedly in talks to acquire software company SAS Institute Inc. for an estimated $15 billion to $20 billion. This potential acquisition would further expand Broadcom's infrastructure software solutions business, aligning with its strategy of growing through significant acquisitions. SAS Institute, based in Cary, is a business analytics software developer that recently transitioned to a subscription-based SaaS model.

title: Microsoft says Israeli group sold tools to hack Windows
summary: Microsoft and Citizen Lab reported that an Israeli company called Candiru sold software tools to hack Microsoft Windows and other widely used software platforms like Google Chrome. These tools were allegedly used to target civil society organizations, including a Saudi dissident group and an Indonesian news outlet, in countries like Iran, Lebanon, Spain, and the UK. Both Microsoft and Google have since patched the vulnerabilities exploited by Candiru's tools.

title: Mespinoza Ransomware Gang Calls Victims “Partners,” Attacks with Gasket, "MagicSocks" Tools
summary: The Mespinoza (also known as PYSA) ransomware gang is a sophisticated cyber extortion group that calls its victims "partners" and uses custom hacking tools named Gasket and "MagicSocks." They target various industries globally, including U.S. publishing, real estate, manufacturing, and education, demanding ransoms up to $1.6 million. The group employs double-extortion tactics, exfiltrating sensitive data before encryption and threatening to leak it if victims refuse to pay.

title: ServiceNow Transforms Hybrid Work with New Solutions to Help Offices Reopen Smoothly
summary: ServiceNow announced updates to its Workplace Service Delivery solution to support hybrid work environments, offering consumer-grade employee experiences and real estate optimization. New features include intelligent reservation capabilities for workspaces, space utilization insights for facilities teams, and enhanced wayfinding through office maps. This aims to help companies smoothly reopen offices and manage flexible work models, as exemplified by ENMAX and ServiceNow's own implementation.

title: NetApp Wins Microsoft’s Global Customer Experience Partner of the Year Award
summary: NetApp has been recognized with Microsoft's Global Customer Experience Partner of the Year Award, an honor that reflects the company's commitment to customer satisfaction and problem-solving over sales. The award acknowledges NetApp's data-driven approach, real-time innovation, and leadership in cloud offerings, as evidenced by extensive customer surveys and interviews. This recognition underscores NetApp's enduring partnership with Microsoft and its dedication to helping customers confidently navigate digital transformation.

title: Top 25 Microsoft Azure Cloud Systems Integrators List -
summary: This article identifies the top 25 Microsoft Azure Cloud Systems Integrators for 2021, based on an Everest Group Peak Matrix report and ChannelE2E's own coverage. It provides an alphabetized list of companies, offering brief insights into some of their key services and employee numbers. The list includes major players like Accenture and Capgemini, as well as emerging integrators.

title: Rebranded N-able appoints new APAC director
summary: N-able, formerly SolarWinds MSP, has appointed Matthew Drake as its new senior sales director for the Asia Pacific (APAC) region. Drake will focus on expanding N-able's presence and supporting managed service provider (MSP) partners, taking over from Jamie Deveaux. He brings extensive experience from previous roles at Malwarebytes and Symantec.

title: Beware of the Sugar Rush: Thoughts on the Google Chrome 3rd Party Cookie Announcement
summary: Google's decision to delay the sunsetting of third-party cookies in Chrome should not lead to complacency for marketers and media owners. Instead, this extra time should be utilized to develop robust first-party data strategies and enhance contextual targeting solutions. The article emphasizes that a cookieless future is inevitable and acting now will create a more sustainable and trustworthy online ecosystem.

title: How to build a successful cloud data architecture
summary: Building a successful cloud data architecture is crucial for enterprises to accelerate data insights, lower IT costs, and gain flexibility. While the cloud offers benefits like scalability and improved security, poor design can lead to increased costs and new security vulnerabilities. Key strategies include starting with a business case, experimenting, taming unstructured data, focusing on workflows, and balancing data requirements with costs.

title: Welcome to the Jam: NBA® 2K21 MyTEAM Season 9 “Out of This World!" Available Friday
summary: 2K has announced the final season of MyTEAM for NBA® 2K21, titled “Out of This World!”, launching on Friday, July 16. This season allows players to collect special Dark Matter cards featuring Damian Lillard, Klay Thompson, Anthony Davis, and LeBron James, with artwork from "Space Jam: A New Legacy." It also introduces NBA 2K21 G.O.A.T. cards, new Invincible Dark Matter rewards, and a signature challenge based on Kobe Bryant's last game.

title: Putting the ‘Q’ in NASDAQ: Quantum Computing Inc. Lists on Nasdaq Capital Market
summary: Quantum Computing Inc. (QCI) has announced its listing on the Nasdaq Capital Market, with common stock trading under the symbol QUBT set to commence on July 15, 2021. QCI aims to democratize quantum computing with its Qatalyst™ software, enabling businesses to solve complex problems without extensive quantum programming expertise. This Nasdaq listing is expected to boost QCI's profile, liquidity, and shareholder value in the investment community.

title: What Zoom's Acquisition Of Five9 Means For Enterprises
summary: Zoom's $14.7 billion acquisition of Five9, a cloud-based contact center, is its largest M&A deal to date. This move aims to enhance Zoom's enterprise offerings by integrating Five9's CCaaS platform with its UCaaS, creating a comprehensive customer engagement solution. The acquisition is expected to impact the contact center market, particularly for enterprises leveraging video integration for improved customer experience, while also raising questions about Five9's shareholder valuation.

title: Zoom is buying cloud contact center provider Five9 for $14.7 billion
summary: Zoom has announced its acquisition of cloud contact center provider Five9 for $14.7 billion in an all-stock transaction. This marks Zoom's first billion-dollar deal and aims to expand its platform beyond video chat, especially as the company anticipates a post-pandemic world and faces a natural slowdown in growth. The acquisition, which represents a 13% premium for Five9 shareholders, is expected to close in the first half of 2022.

title: The Zoom-Five9 deal is a big bet for the video conferencing company
summary: Zoom has announced its intent to acquire Five9 for $14.7 billion, representing nearly 15% of Zoom's market capitalization. This acquisition is seen as a significant bet for Zoom to expand its offerings beyond video conferencing and tap into Five9's customer base, despite Five9's slower revenue growth compared to Zoom's core business. The deal aims to enhance total addressable market and create accretive value for both companies.

title: Focus: Getting the cap on the bottle: Inside P&G's robot ambitions
summary: Procter & Gamble (P&G) is using advanced robotics and automation to maintain its competitive edge in the consumer goods market by reducing manufacturing costs and improving efficiency. Despite being known for branding, P&G develops its own automation solutions, focusing on tasks like precise packaging and handling diverse product shapes. This push for automation is also driven by the need for social distancing during the pandemic and labor shortages, with P&G continuously exploring new robotic applications for its factories.

title: Zoom to buy cloud-based call center operator Five9 in $15 bln deal
summary: Zoom Video Communications announced its largest-ever acquisition, an all-stock deal to buy cloud-based call center operator Five9 Inc for $14.7 billion. This strategic move aims to expand Zoom's offerings beyond video conferencing into the $24 billion contact center market, enhancing its presence with enterprise customers. The deal is expected to close in the first half of 2022, with Five9 becoming an operating unit of Zoom.

title: EU and China Announce Greenhouse Gas Reduction Plans
summary: The EU and China have announced significant plans to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. The EU's plan involves cutting reliance on fossil fuels, imposing taxes on imports from high-emitting countries, and increasing renewable energy goals. China launched a domestic cap-and-trade style emissions market, doubling the global emissions covered under such a program.

title: Zoom to Acquire Five9: Turns its Focus on the Contact Center
summary: Zoom Video Communications Inc. (ZM.O) announced its acquisition of cloud software provider Five9 Inc. (FIVN.O) in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $14.7 billion. This strategic move aims to diversify Zoom's business beyond its core video conferencing services by expanding into the contact center market. The acquisition is seen as a logical horizontal expansion for Zoom, leveraging Five9's cloud-native offerings and significant growth.

title: GlobalFoundries Plans to Build New Fab in Upstate New York in Private-Public Partnership to Support U.S. Semiconductor Manufacturing
summary: GlobalFoundries announced plans to expand its most advanced manufacturing facility in upstate New York, including immediate investments to address the global chip shortage and the construction of a new fab to double the site's capacity. This expansion, a private-public partnership, will create over 1,000 new high-tech jobs and support growing demand from markets like automotive and 5G, as well as national security requirements. The effort is part of GF's broader global expansion to meet worldwide customer demand.

title: 13 Best Server Security Services
summary: This article reviews 13 top server security services, highlighting the critical importance of server protection against hackers and ransomware. It details various solutions, including firewalls, incident response software, vulnerability scanning, secure connectivity, cloud data protection, site recovery, and VPNs. The services aim to protect databases, confidential information, and enterprise user files, adapting to the increasing virtualization of servers.

title: Solarwinds Spin-Off N-able Goes Public With Clear Focus On MSP Mission
summary: N-able, a spin-off from SolarWinds, completed its IPO with a strong focus on empowering MSPs to serve small and medium enterprises. Despite N-able's shares falling post-IPO, former parent SolarWinds saw its share price rise. N-able aims to be a "rule of 50" company by prioritizing growth and investing in new technologies to better support its MSP partners.

title: Business Process Management Platform as a Service Market: Ready
summary: Ample Market Research & Consulting Private Limited has published a new study on the Business Process Management Platform as a Service (BPM PaaS) Market, evaluating its trends, opportunities, and risks. The report provides a detailed perspective on the BPM PaaS industry, segmented by applications like BFSI, Manufacturing, and Retail, and by product types such as Cloud BPM and On-premises BPM. It includes market sizes, growth forecasts up to 2025, and profiles key players including OpenText, Adobe Systems, and Oracle.

title: 4 best practices for big data security in cloud computing
summary: Securing big data in the cloud is crucial due to the vast amounts of sensitive information involved. This article outlines four best practices for big data security in cloud computing, including architectural design, least privilege tactics, data encryption, and continuous monitoring. These strategies help businesses protect data integrity, prevent theft, and ensure regulatory compliance in cloud environments.

title: Microsoft acquires security start-up CloudKnox
summary: Microsoft announced its acquisition of CloudKnox, a security start-up that develops software to help companies manage and reduce access permissions to their cloud resources. This acquisition is part of Microsoft's broader strategy to expand its security business, which has seen over $10 billion in revenue in the prior 12 months. CloudKnox's software functions across Microsoft Azure, Amazon, and Google public clouds, identifying and removing unused permissions and flagging unusual activity to prevent security breaches.

title: What’s Changed: The 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management
summary: This article highlights the key changes in the 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), the third iteration of the report. It details how Gartner defines PAM, analyzes the intensely competitive market, and reviews the placements of various vendors within the Niche Players, Challengers, and Leaders quadrants, noting significant shifts for several companies and the absence of new vendors.

title: After $27.7 bln deal, Salesforce aims to connect companies via Slack
summary: Salesforce.com has completed its $27.7 billion acquisition of Slack Technologies Inc., aiming to make Slack a primary platform for collaboration both within and between companies. This acquisition strengthens Salesforce's position against Microsoft Corp.'s Teams app. Both companies hope to simplify the use of numerous cloud-based applications and improve interoperability for their joint customers, emphasizing seamless business deals and communication.

title: Internet down: What is Akamai as PSN and other sites go offline?
summary: A global internet outage impacted numerous major sites, including PlayStation Network and several UK banks, due to issues with content delivery network (CDN) Akamai. This outage follows a similar incident involving Fastly months prior, highlighting the critical role CDNs play in internet infrastructure. While the exact cause of Akamai's disruption was initially unclear, the company confirmed it was not a cyberattack and services were restored.

title: Carter's Inc. Jeff Jenkins Shares How the Brand Is Bringing Childhood Dreams to Life
summary: Jeff Jenkins, EVP of Global Marketing at Carter's Inc., discusses his decision to join the brand due to a deep emotional connection to parenthood. He highlights Carter's latest campaign featuring younger versions of American icons, including Mariah Carey's daughter, Monroe. Jenkins also emphasizes the importance of a strong leadership team and shares insights on mentorship and brand history.

title: What skill set does a chief hybrid work officer need?
summary: The rise of hybrid work models in response to the pandemic has led some companies to consider dedicated roles like a chief hybrid work officer. This article outlines the essential skill sets required for such a position, emphasizing strong communication, technical know-how, and a generalist's perspective. These leaders are tasked with rethinking work paradigms and ensuring equitable, efficient collaboration in a flexible environment.

title: Companies Are Embracing Empathy to Keep Employees Happy. It’s Not That Easy
summary: Companies are increasingly promoting empathy in the workplace, but many employees view these initiatives with skepticism. The article explores why corporate empathy programs often fall short, highlighting the tension between genuine support for employees and the primary capitalist goal of maximizing profits. It suggests that a deeper, societal cultural deficit in empathy contributes to the challenges of fostering a truly empathetic work environment.

title: Rackspace Layoffs, Offshore Strategy Buried in 'Growth' Announcement -
summary: Rackspace Technology announced plans to invest up to $75 million in growth, while simultaneously conducting layoffs affecting 10% of its workforce and shifting job responsibilities offshore. The company's press release focused on growth and financial guidance, but an SEC filing revealed the "termination" of employees and the backfilling of roles in offshore service centers. This led to criticism of Rackspace's "overly ambitious PR spin" for obscuring the job cuts despite increasing financial forecasts.

title: In a World Let Loose, Video Game Makers Are ‘Doubling Down’
summary: Despite warnings of potential sales dips as people return to pre-pandemic activities, video game companies like Riot Games and Microsoft's Xbox are accelerating their investments and hiring. They are betting on continued growth and using pandemic-era financial windfalls to expand operations, a strategy also adopted by other tech companies that thrived during lockdowns.

title: Better Buy: Invesco QQQ or Fidelity MSCI IT Index ETF
summary: This article compares the Invesco QQQ and Fidelity MSCI IT Index ETF, both strong technology-focused ETFs. While QQQ tracks the Nasdaq 100 and holds diverse sectors, the Fidelity ETF is a pure-play IT fund with broader diversification within the tech sector. The author concludes that the Fidelity ETF is the better buy due to its higher historical returns, lower expense ratio, and more consistent performance.

title: Tobi Lutke becomes Canada’s wealthiest company founder as Shopify shares soar
summary: Tobi Lutke, founder and CEO of Shopify Inc., has become Canada's wealthiest company founder as his stake in the e-commerce software provider reached US$13.3-billion. This surge in wealth is attributed to Shopify's stock crossing the $2,000 mark on the Toronto Stock Exchange and increasing optimism surrounding the company's second-quarter earnings. Analysts have raised their price targets for Shopify, anticipating its revenue to surpass US$1-billion for the first time in the June 30 quarter.

title: Corporations want to shake Microsoft Excel. It’s not so easy.
summary: CFOs are increasingly looking to replace Microsoft Excel due to weaknesses exposed by remote work, such as its unsuitability for certain tasks, time-consuming manual data entry, and unnoticed errors. While corporations are exploring automated platforms like SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, and Workiva, transitioning away from Excel is challenging due to implementation time, employee learning curves, and Excel's widespread adoption and integration within the Microsoft Office suite. Despite new alternatives, Excel's dominance continues to grow, making replacement an uphill battle for finance chiefs.

title: As global demand for microchips surges, tech giants go all-in on Israel
summary: Amid a global surge in microchip demand and a component shortage, major tech companies like Google, Microsoft, Facebook, Intel, and Nvidia are establishing or expanding chip design operations in Israel. The country is benefiting from its strong R&D capabilities and skilled workforce in semiconductor design. This trend is attracting increased venture capital investment, despite challenges like a shortage of engineers and rising salaries.

title: IoT Search Engines Make It Easy to Find Vulnerable Devices, and That's a Problem
summary: This article discusses how IoT search engines, despite their utility, pose significant security risks by making it easy for both white hats and malicious actors to identify vulnerable internet-connected devices. It highlights two VMware vCenter Server vulnerabilities as examples where exploits quickly followed disclosure, aided by these search engines. The author provides five tips for organizations to protect themselves, including leveraging these tools for self-assessment, minimizing attack surface, and restricting information sharing.

title: Sparkline Launches Intangible Value ETF, ‘ITAN’
summary: Sparkline Capital has launched the Sparkline Intangible Value ETF (ITAN), an actively managed fund that evaluates companies based on their "intangible value." This value is derived from four pillars: intellectual property, brand equity, human capital, and network effects, integrated with tangible assets using machine learning. The fund aims to provide a modern interpretation of value investing by focusing on high-quality companies with strong intangible drivers of growth.

title: BlackRock, Others Invest $450 Million on PsiQuantum
summary: PsiQuantum has secured $450 million in Series D funding led by Blackrock, with participation from Baillie Gifford, Quantum1 Group, M12 – Microsoft's venture fund, Blackbird Ventures, and Temasek. The Palo Alto-based company, which leverages a photonic approach to quantum computing, plans to use the funds to expand its team and build a 1 million-quantum-bit machine. This latest funding round brings PsiQuantum's total raised since 2016 to $665 million and values the company at $3.15 billion, making it one of the largest independent Quantum Technology companies.

title: Check Point CloudGuard Improves Google Cloud Security with Exciting New Capabilities for Managed Instance ...
summary: Check Point CloudGuard has introduced significant enhancements for Google Cloud security, focusing on automation and ease-of-use with Managed Instance Groups (MIGs). The updates allow CloudGuard to seamlessly integrate with dynamic MIG functionalities for inbound, outbound, and East-West traffic, including auto-scaling and automatic health check responses. A key improvement is the adoption of Google Cloud's symmetric hashing, which eliminates the need for Source NAT (SNAT) in East-West traffic inspection, thereby improving performance and preserving the true source IP for applications.

title: Element bolsters decentralized team messaging with $30M raise
summary: Element, a company behind an end-to-end encrypted team messaging platform powered by the Matrix protocol, has raised $30 million in Series B funding. This funding comes from notable backers including Skype cofounder Jaan Tallinn's Metaplanet, Automattic, Protocol Labs, and Notion. The investment highlights the growing importance of decentralized, open-source communication solutions amidst major acquisitions like Salesforce's Slack takeover and increasing concerns over data sovereignty and privacy.

title: HCA Healthcare Appoints Hugh F. Johnston as New Independent Director
summary: HCA Healthcare announced the appointment of Hugh F. Johnston, vice chairman and CFO of PepsiCo, Inc., as an independent director to its board, effective September 1, 2021. This addition expands the board to 10 members, with Johnston also joining the audit and compliance, and finance and investments committees. CEO Sam Hazen highlighted Johnston's extensive financial, operational, and technological expertise as a valuable asset to the company's patient-centered mission.

title: HP To Acquire Teradici: ‘Huge Asset’ In Remote Computing Push
summary: HP Inc. announced its agreement to acquire Teradici, a high-performance remote computing software firm, to bolster its offerings in virtual computing technologies for the hybrid work market. Teradici's technology enables secure and high-fidelity remote access to computing, including for graphics-intensive workloads, and is platform-agnostic. This acquisition aims to complement HP's PC business with software and services, integrating well with solutions like Microsoft's Windows 365, and expanding opportunities for HP's channel partners.

title: Microsoft cloud strength fuels fourth quarter results
summary: Microsoft announced strong fourth-quarter and full fiscal year 2021 results, driven by significant growth in its commercial cloud revenue. The company reported substantial increases across revenue, operating income, net income, and diluted earnings per share, with key contributions from sectors like Office 365 Commercial, Azure, LinkedIn, and Dynamics 365. Microsoft also detailed its shareholder returns and provided insight into a non-GAAP adjustment related to a tax benefit in India.

title: Microsoft acquires Seattle startup Suplari, which uses AI to analyze corporate spending
summary: Microsoft has acquired Suplari, a Seattle-based startup that leverages artificial intelligence to help companies analyze and manage corporate spending effectively. Suplari's technology provides recommendations for cost savings and risk exposure by analyzing procurement and spending data, which Microsoft plans to integrate with its Dynamics 365 offering. This acquisition highlights the growing trend of using AI and machine learning to automate data-intensive financial processes.

title: $264.7 million building permit issued by West Des Moines for Microsoft Corp.'s newest data center project
summary: West Des Moines has issued a $264.7 million building permit for Microsoft Corp.'s newest data center project, Project Ginger West. This permit was part of over $499.2 million in commercial permits issued in the Des Moines area in June, contributing to over $1.3 billion in the first half of 2021. The new data center will be a 184,596-square-foot building on Microsoft's 188-acre campus.

title: Zynga Inc. Cl A stock rises Wednesday, outperforms market
summary: Zynga Inc. Cl A (ZNGA) stock rose 1.08% on Wednesday, closing at $10.25 and outperforming the broader market. Despite the gain, the stock remains $2.07 short of its 52-week high. Competitors such as Microsoft Corp. (MSFT) fell, while Electronic Arts Inc. (EA) and Take-Two Interactive Software Inc. (TTWO) also saw gains.

title: Nice expands contact center AI offering with ContactEngine buy
summary: Nice acquired ContactEngine, a conversational AI technology provider, to enhance its CXone suite with natural language AI for customer self-service and proactive customer communications. This acquisition allows Nice to automate customer interactions, anticipate needs, and route calls more efficiently, especially benefiting field service management by automating site visit confirmations and rescheduling. The move is part of Nice's active acquisition strategy in the competitive cloud contact center platform sector.

title: Microsoft’s M12 and Qualcomm Ventures – Joined by Hitachi Ventures – Co-Lead Series C Round for Award-Winning Robotics Company, inVia Robotics
summary: InVia Robotics, a company specializing in warehouse automation solutions, has secured $30 million in Series C funding. The round was co-led by M12 (Microsoft’s venture fund), Qualcomm Ventures, and Hitachi Ventures, with participation from existing investors. This funding aims to expand inVia's product reach, support operations in North America, and drive market expansion into APAC and EMEA, leveraging the Qualcomm® Robotics RB5 Platform.

title: Vittorio Cretella left school at 17 to join the Italian Army. Now he’s CIO at Procter & Gamble.
summary: Vittorio Cretella, CIO of Procter & Gamble, discusses his unconventional career path from the Italian Army to leading digital transformation at the $300+ billion CPG company. He emphasizes the importance of diversity and inclusion in hiring, along with the pervasive role of digital transformation, machine learning, and cloud adoption in P&G's strategy. Cretella also highlights his work with NPower, a non-profit helping veterans and underserved youth find careers in tech, and P&G's neurodiversity hiring program.

title: Even if India Inc calls their employees back, we are leaving it to our employees to decide: Rajiv Burman, S&..
summary: Rajiv Burman, People Lead - India at S&P Global, discussed his company's "People's First" approach and its impact on HR policies during the COVID-19 pandemic. He highlighted measures like technology allowances, rapid response teams, wellness programs, and special leave provisions. Burman also indicated S&P Global's plans to offer hybrid working options and allow employees to decide whether to return to the office, even if other Indian companies mandate it.

title: AudioCodes RXVCam10 Personal Cam Review
summary: The AudioCodes RXVCam10 personal webcam offers exceptional image clarity with 1080p full HD video and plug-and-play compatibility, making it ideal for today's remote and hybrid workers. It integrates seamlessly with a variety of UC platforms like Zoom and Microsoft Teams, as well as AudioCodes' own ecosystem, providing flexibility and ease of use. The camera features automatic light adjustment and a portable design, ensuring high-quality video in diverse working environments.

title: Apple Is Now an Antifragile Company
summary: This article argues that Apple has transformed into an "antifragile" company under Tim Cook's leadership, meaning it improves under stress rather than just resisting it. The company's resilience stems from its robust supply chain management, significant cash reserves, and diversified product and service portfolio, which allowed it to thrive amidst the challenges of 2020. While potential threats like government regulation, future leadership changes, and geopolitical issues remain, Apple's recent performance suggests a strong footing for continued success.

title: Palo Alto Networks Discloses New Attack Surface Targeting Microsoft IIS and SQL Server at Black Hat Asia 2021
summary: Palo Alto Networks has revealed a new attack surface for Microsoft IIS and SQL Server, leveraging a previously undisclosed technique to execute SQL queries on remote databases via vulnerabilities in the Microsoft Jet Database Engine. This attack can grant threat actors SYSTEM privilege remotely, particularly through SQL injection or ad hoc scenarios. While Microsoft released a complex patch (CVE-2021-28455) to mitigate this by disabling remote table access, it is turned off by default, and many Jet vulnerabilities remain unpatched, necessitating proactive mitigation by users.

title: How SAP and Deutsche Boerse Are Paving the Way to the Public Cloud for the Finance Industry
summary: SAP and Deutsche Boerse have collaborated to create a framework for secure and compliant hosting of sensitive financial data in the public cloud, addressing the strict regulatory requirements of the financial sector. This solution, based on SAP Data Custodian, allows financial service providers like Deutsche Boerse to maintain full control over their data, ensure data sovereignty, and protect sensitive information while leveraging the scalability and agility of cloud technology. The initiative aims to enable more financial institutions to move critical operations to the cloud, overcoming concerns about security and compliance.

title: Google’s upcoming plans for Israel: a server farm and fiber optics network
summary: Google is significantly expanding its operations in Israel following being awarded a government tender for cloud computing. This expansion includes establishing a server farm in the Sharon region and rolling out an ultra-high-speed fiber optics network, complementing its existing subsea cables. These investments aim to ensure maximum availability of Google's services, improve local internet infrastructure, and enhance Google's presence as a global telecommunications provider.

title: News Corp bets big on data with $1.2 bln OPIS buy
summary: News Corp announced its acquisition of Oil Price Information Service (OPIS) and related assets from S&P Global and IHS Markit for $1.15 billion in cash. This strategic move aims to expand News Corp's energy, commodity, and renewables database, integrating OPIS into its Dow Jones' Professional Information Business. The deal, expected to close in Q4 2021, underscores News Corp's focus on data-driven growth.

title: HP Elite Dragonfly G2 review: Updated premium 2-in-1 gains performance, but not weight
summary: The HP Elite Dragonfly G2 is a premium 2-in-1 convertible laptop that offers updated 11th-generation Intel Core processors without significantly increasing its lightweight design. While it maintains its impressive portability and versatile features like a "sanitization mode" for cleaning, the 4K display option, though visually appealing, can notably reduce battery life. Despite its high price point and some minor display shortcomings, it remains a strong contender for users prioritizing an ultraportable and fully-featured device for general productivity.

title: Deal Of The Century: How Michael Dell Turned His Declining PC Business Into A $40 Billion Windfall
summary: Michael Dell orchestrated a massive comeback for his company, Dell Technologies, transforming it from a declining PC business into an IT infrastructure giant with a $40 billion windfall for investors and a personal net worth of $50 billion. Through strategic leveraged buyouts, including taking the company private in 2013 and acquiring EMC in 2016, Dell successfully pivoted towards data center infrastructure, cloud management services, and the "edge" market. His financial engineering acumen and willingness to take on debt, combined with a correct reading of technology industry trends, allowed him to reassemble his empire and spin off VMware, solidifying his position in enterprise technology.

title: Baxter extends Amazon Web Services collaboration to support new digital health, data management projects
summary: Baxter is expanding its long-term partnership with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to focus on new digital health tools, supply chain efficiency, and deeper insights from business operations. This collaboration aims to enhance its DoseEdge software, improve supply chain responsiveness through AWS analytics, and further develop remote patient management systems like its AWS-powered Sharesource platform. The move is part of Baxter's ongoing "digital transformation" and builds on its recent sales growth.

title: How to Use Snowflake to Connect Your Systems and Centralize Your Data to Prevent Customer Churn
summary: This article explains how to use Snowflake as a data hub to centralize data from various systems, such as AS400 and Salesforce, to prevent customer churn. It details the steps for connecting AWS S3 data to Snowflake using Snowpipes and integrating Salesforce data, demonstrating how a Senior Data Architect would implement this solution. The integration aims to provide a holistic view of customer information, enabling proactive measures against churn.

title: Baxter Begins Collaboration with Amazon Web Services
summary: Baxter International Inc. is accelerating its digital transformation by collaborating with Amazon Web Services (AWS) across digital health solutions, customer experience, and technology modernization. This multi-year strategic agreement focuses on leveraging cloud technology to personalize patient care, enhance customer experiences, and modernize business processes, building on their existing work of migrating Baxter's data centers to the cloud. The transformation has already enabled advancements in home dialysis patient management with Sharesource and pharmacy workflow with DoseEdge, while also improving supply chain resilience during the pandemic.

title: Logitech Debuts Wireless Earbuds Built for Business
summary: Logitech has launched new Zone True Wireless and Zone Wired Earbuds, designed for business professionals in hybrid work environments. These earbuds are among the first to be certified by major video conferencing platforms like Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Zoom, offering superior audio quality, active noise cancellation, and seamless connectivity across multiple devices. The wireless version provides double the battery life of leading consumer devices and will be available in Fall 2021 starting at $299.

title: R1 Appoints Jay Sreedharan as Chief Technology and Digital Officer
summary: R1 RCM, a leader in healthcare technology solutions, has appointed Jay Sreedharan as its first Chief Technology and Digital Officer. Sreedharan, with over 20 years of experience from companies like Microsoft, Starbucks, and MGM Resorts, will lead R1's digital transformation, focusing on creating solutions that enhance patient and provider experiences through technology and innovation. His role will encompass strategy, engineering, product development, and potential digital M&A.

title: The Ultimate Hack Job: Why H&R Block Seeks Non-Traditional Talent for Its Cybersecurity Team
summary: H&R Block is actively seeking non-traditional talent for its cybersecurity team, leveraging partnerships with 2U-powered boot camps to find candidates with diverse backgrounds and perspectives. Carraig Stanwyck, a former H&R Block manager now director of information security at Wave, emphasizes that soft skills, work ethic, and passion are more critical than traditional degrees or certifications due to the rapidly evolving nature of cybersecurity. This approach allows H&R Block to address the industry's talent shortage and foster a progressive, inclusive environment where boot camp graduates can advance internally.

title: Qualys partners with Red Hat to secure OpenShift and CoreOS
summary: Qualys Inc. has announced a partnership with Red Hat Inc. to enhance the security of enterprise Linux and Kubernetes deployments, specifically focusing on Red Hat Enterprise Linux CoreOS and Red Hat OpenShift. Qualys will integrate its Cloud Agent with these platforms, providing continuous discovery of vulnerabilities and enabling runtime monitoring and blocking of unwanted container behavior. This collaboration aims to simplify security for containerized workloads, offering comprehensive inventory and threat management capabilities.

title: Opinion | If You Paid Your Debt to Society, You Should Be Allowed to Work (Published 2021)
summary: Jamie Dimon, chairman and CEO of JPMorgan Chase, argues that individuals who have paid their debt to society should be allowed to work, highlighting that nearly half of formerly incarcerated people are unemployed one year after leaving prison. He advocates for removing financial, legal, and logistical barriers that prevent re-entry into the workforce and shares JPMorgan Chase's efforts, including banning the "box" on job applications and establishing a Second Chance hiring program. Dimon also mentions the formation of the Second Chance Business Coalition with other major companies to promote best practices in hiring people with criminal backgrounds.

title: Microsoft improves marketing operations efficiency with Microsoft Power Automate
summary: Microsoft's Global Demand Center leveraged Microsoft Power Automate to significantly improve the efficiency of its marketing operations, reduce costs, and free up employee time for higher-level tasks. By automating standardized and repeatable tasks in Adobe Marketo Engage, the GDC achieved a 26% reduction in program build costs and saved thousands of employee hours, while expanding its scope to cover the entire commercial portfolio. The initiative demonstrates how intelligent automation can sustain growth and innovation while managing budget constraints, with future plans to expand these capabilities to field marketers.

title: QQQ Versus QQQJ: Who’s Winning the Battle?
summary: This article compares the performance of the Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) and the Invesco NASDAQ Next Gen 100 ETF (QQQJ). QQQ, which focuses on large-cap tech companies, has outperformed QQQJ, a mid-cap focused ETF, across various timeframes. Chad Morganlander of Washington Crossing Advisors favors QQQ due to its higher quality large-cap names and stronger balance sheets.

title: When Value Chains Become Value Networks, Business Becomes Sustainable
summary: Digitalization is driving businesses to prioritize flexibility and high ethical and environmental standards across their operations and supply chains. By transforming traditional value chains into interconnected value networks, companies can achieve sustainability goals more effectively, minimize carbon footprints, reduce waste, and ensure social equity. SAP Business Network facilitates this shift by providing transparency, collaboration, and intelligence for responsible sourcing, logistics, and asset management, ultimately fostering a greener economy.

title: Elastic Announces the General Availability of Elastic Agent, General Availability of Support for Microsoft Azure Private Link, and New Visualization Capabilities in Kibana
summary: Elastic (NYSE: ESTC) has announced general availability for Elastic Agent, centrally managed by Fleet, to simplify data onboarding and management in the Elastic Stack and Elastic Cloud. The company is also rolling out general availability of support for Microsoft Azure Private Link, enhancing data security for cloud deployments. Additionally, new visualization capabilities have been introduced in Kibana, including time-shifted metrics, custom formulas, and a time slider in Elastic Maps for improved ad hoc analytics.

title: Exxon booted from carbon tax alliance after lobbying scandal
summary: Exxon Mobil Corp. has been suspended from the Climate Leadership Council, a prominent pro-carbon tax group, following a scandal where an Exxon lobbyist was recorded admitting the company's public support for a carbon tax was disingenuous. The lobbyist stated Exxon believed such a policy would be nearly impossible to implement. Despite an apology from Exxon's CEO, the council deemed the comments unacceptable, highlighting ongoing pressure on the oil giant to demonstrate genuine commitment to climate action.

title: Absolute Software Appoints Andre Mintz to Board
summary: Absolute Software Corporation announced the appointment of Andre Mintz to its Board of Directors, effective August 5, 2021. Mintz brings over 30 years of experience in information security and cyber risk management, having previously served as CISO for Newport Group and holding key security roles at Red Ventures, Reuters, Microsoft, and Kinko's. His expertise is expected to be invaluable in accelerating Absolute's growth and expanding its portfolio of resilient security solutions.

title: ServiceNow Acquires Database Performance Software Company Swarm64 -
summary: ServiceNow has acquired Swarm64, a Berlin-based database performance software company, to enhance its ability to scale digital workflows and handle growing data volumes for customers. Swarm64, founded in 2013 and previously venture-backed by Intel Capital and Xilinx, specializes in combining analytics and transactional database functionality. This acquisition aligns with ServiceNow's broader strategy of evolving its offerings beyond IT service management and expanding its partner ecosystem.

title: Nuveen Dividend Growth ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (NYSEARCA:NDVG)
summary: The Nuveen Dividend Growth ETF (NDVG) is an actively managed, non-transparent ETF launched on August 4, 2021, that primarily invests in dividend-paying equities globally, utilizing the Natixis/NYSE non-transparent model. The ETF has current assets under management of $13.14 million, a dividend yield of 4.39%, and a net expense ratio of 0.65%. Its top holdings include major tech and financial companies like Apple, Microsoft, Broadcom, and JPMorgan Chase & Co.

title: Quantum Computing Stocks Are Having a Moment
summary: This article explores the current state of quantum computing stocks, highlighting that while many large tech companies are "dabbling" in the field, pure-play quantum computing investments are still rare and often speculative. It reviews major players like IonQ, Microsoft, Amazon, Google, NVIDIA, Honeywell, and IBM, noting that many fundamental breakthroughs and commercially viable products are still years away. The author also warns against speculative investments, particularly those involving new SPACs and OTC stocks, and suggests that true quantum supremacy may not be publicly disclosed.

title: GE Healthcare Brings Radiology Without Walls to Resource-Constrained Small Imaging Centers With AI-Enabled, Cloud Imaging Solution
summary: GE Healthcare has launched Edison True PACS, an AI-enabled, cloud-based Picture Archive and Communication System designed to help resource-constrained small imaging centers and community hospitals improve efficiency and diagnostic precision. This solution addresses challenges like radiologist shortages and IT resource limitations, offering remote reading capabilities and seamless integration of AI algorithms. It is available as a SaaS or on-premise offering with flexible subscription models to match varying organizational needs and budgets.

title: SoftBank pauses China investing as crackdown roils portfolio
summary: SoftBank Group Corp will pause new investments in China due to regulatory actions against Chinese tech firms, according to CEO Masayoshi Son. Despite the crackdown impacting valuations of previous investments like Didi Global Inc and Full Truck Alliance, SoftBank's Vision Fund CFO Navneet Govil stated that their long-term thesis for China remains unchanged due to its compelling economic opportunity. The fund reported a profit of 236 billion yen in the first quarter, with further upside expected from upcoming listings of Indian firms Paytm and Policybazaar, and Southeast Asian ride-hailer Grab.

title: Microsoft acquires Israeli company Peer5 to improve live video in Teams
summary: Microsoft has acquired Peer5, an Israeli company specializing in enterprise CDN (eCDN) solutions for video streaming, to enhance large-scale live video capabilities within Microsoft Teams. This acquisition aims to optimize network performance for the 145 million daily Teams users, especially in a hybrid work environment. All of Peer5's team will integrate into Microsoft Israel R&D, though the acquisition amount was not disclosed.

title: Global Quantum Computing Market to Reach $411.4 Million by 2026
summary: The global quantum computing market is projected to grow significantly, reaching $411.4 million by 2026 from $112.6 million in 2020, driven by increased funding, rising cybercrime, and adoption in emerging technologies like AI and machine learning. The report highlights critical applications in material simulation, optimization, and end-use sectors such as space and defense, with the U.S. and China leading market growth. This expansion is supported by government initiatives and investments in infrastructure across major geographies.

title: Xbox Partners with Special Olympics for the Inaugural Gaming for Inclusion Esports Tournament
summary: Xbox and Special Olympics are launching "Gaming for Inclusion," an inaugural esports experience taking place from September 12-14, 2021. This event builds on their long-standing partnership, aiming to empower Special Olympics athletes and promote inclusion through competitive gaming in titles like Rocket League, Madden NFL 22, and Forza Motorsport 7. The tournament seeks to combat isolation and allow athletes to compete alongside celebrity supporters, with broadcasts available on Twitch and YouTube.

title: Retailer Sonae accelerates productivity and streamlines HR processes with Power Automate
summary: Sonae, a multinational corporation, is leveraging Microsoft Power Automate to accelerate productivity and streamline HR processes as part of its digital transformation initiative. The company successfully used Power Automate to automate its trainee internship program's interview scheduling, significantly reducing manual effort and errors. Additionally, Power Automate, combined with Microsoft AI Builder, was instrumental in rapidly processing COVID-19 test results, freeing medical staff and ensuring timely communication during the pandemic.

title: Expedia Group pushes back its full return to the office to January 2022
summary: Expedia Group has announced a delay in its full return to office plans, now targeting January 2022 for a hybrid model due to evolving COVID-19 circumstances. This decision follows similar moves by other major tech companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, and Apple. The company's U.S. offices are open to vaccinated employees and visitors in the interim, with a global evaluation for similar approaches.

title: Antisemitism Watchdog Gives Corporate Giants Failing Grades in Handling of Antisemitism
summary: Stop Antisemitism released a report grading major U.S. corporations on their handling of antisemitism, giving "F" grades to Google, Unilever, and Cigna for various shortcomings. The report criticized Google for not firing an employee with a problematic past statement and omitting antisemitism from diversity standards, Unilever for Ben & Jerry's stance on "Occupied Palestinian Territory" and lack of Jewish representation in diversity policies, and Cigna for similar omissions. Only L'Oreal and American Eagle Outfitters received "A" grades for proactive measures against antisemitism and fostering Jewish employee groups, respectively, highlighting a general failure of corporations to protect Jewish employees and address rising antisemitism.

title: What's Changed: 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Services
summary: This article analyzes the 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Services (CIPS), highlighting key movements and strategies of the seven leading providers: Alibaba Cloud, Amazon Web Services, Google, IBM, Microsoft, Oracle, and Tencent Cloud. AWS maintains its dominant leadership, with Microsoft and Google also holding strong positions in the Leaders quadrant by focusing on operational databases, big data, and edge computing, respectively. The report details the evolving strategies of Visionary and Niche Players, including Alibaba's expansion beyond Asia, Oracle's commitment to its cloud infrastructure, IBM's restructuring to focus on hybrid/edge computing, and Tencent's investment in network capabilities for gaming.

title: Where Will Competition in Big Tech Lead Investors?
summary: The article discusses the competitive landscape between big tech companies, specifically Amazon and Microsoft, in the cloud computing sector. This rivalry, exemplified by their legal battles over government contracts, creates trading opportunities for investors. The Direxion Daily Dow Jones Internet Bull 3X Shares (WEBL) is highlighted for those bullish on the sector, while the Direxion Daily Cloud Computing Bear 2X Shares (CLDL) is suggested for investors anticipating a downturn in cloud computing.

title: Chipotle’s Marketing Account Hacked: Protect Yourself From Phishing Lures
summary: Chipotle's email marketing vendor, Mailgun, was recently breached, allowing hackers to send phishing emails to Chipotle customers. These malicious emails, sent under the guise of Chipotle, lured unsuspecting users to credential-harvesting sites and even included malware attachments. The article advises consumers on how to protect themselves from such sophisticated phishing scams by doing research, refraining from providing personal data, verifying URLs, and using comprehensive security software.

title: Anexinet To Acquire Cisco Partner Light Networks For ‘Full Stack’ Data Center Offering
summary: Anexinet is set to acquire Light Networks, a Cisco Premier partner, to bolster its data center services, particularly in unified communications and contact center as a service. This acquisition, backed by Mill Point Capital, is Anexinet's second in a year, aiming to expand its "full stack" data center offerings and geographic footprint, specifically focusing on the East Coast and potentially other cloud capabilities. The founders of Light Networks, headquartered in Atlanta, will continue to lead the business.

title: What’s Changed: 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Sales Force Automation
summary: Gartner, Inc. released the 2021 version of its Magic Quadrant for Sales Force Automation, identifying 16 significant SFA providers based on "Completeness of Vision" and "Ability to Execute." The report highlights market growth, changes in vendor rankings, and key functionalities necessary for successful SFA applications. It details leading vendors like Salesforce, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Creatio, along with Challengers, Niche Players, and Visionaries.

title: 8 insights from a chat with Joe DeVivo, Teladoc’s head of hospitals and health systems
summary: Joe DeVivo, Teladoc's president of hospitals and health systems, shared eight key insights from the HIMSS21 conference, discussing the company's strategies and the future of virtual care. Teladoc is focusing on hospital-at-home models, risk management for chronic patients, and deeper integration of virtual care within health systems. The company also hinted at R&D with Microsoft and plans for an API marketplace, projecting 20-30% of post-pandemic visits to be virtual.

title: Project Chess: The Story Behind the Original IBM PC
summary: This article recounts the story of "Project Chess," the initiative behind the original IBM Personal Computer, which was introduced on August 12, 1981. It highlights IBM's unconventional decision to develop the PC outside its traditional bureaucracy, led by William C. "Bill" Lowe and later Philip D. QQQM offers a lower expense ratio of 0.15% compared to QQQ's 0.20%, positioning it well to benefit from renewed investor interest in growth stocks like Apple and Microsoft.

title: Transforming change management at Microsoft with Microsoft 365
summary: This article details how Microsoft adapted its change management strategies for Microsoft 365 as it transitioned to a Software as a Service (SaaS) model. It highlights the challenges of integrating continuous updates, the impact of remote work, and the role of AI in reducing meeting fatigue. The piece outlines Microsoft's approach to change management, focusing on initial triage, implementing guardrails for innovation, and staying current with updates, using concepts like 'posture' and 'ring structure' for controlled deployment.

title: HPE wins $2B contract with the NSA
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) has secured a 10-year, $2 billion contract with the National Security Agency (NSA). This agreement involves the NSA leveraging HPE's high-performance computing technology through the HPE GreenLake platform. HPE will build and manage a comprehensive HPC solution, encompassing HPE Apollo systems and HPE ProLiant servers, capable of processing vast amounts of data and supporting AI capabilities, to be hosted in a QTS data center and operational by 2022.

title: Apollo completes its $5B acquisition of Verizon Media, now known as Yahoo
summary: Private equity firm Apollo Global Management has finalized its $5 billion acquisition of Verizon Media, which will now be known as Yahoo.
