The deal, comprising $4.25 billion in cash and $750 million in preferred interests, leaves Verizon with a 10% stake in the newly rebranded company. This move signifies the end of Verizon's costly endeavor into online media and adtech, with Apollo promising to invest in and grow Yahoo's various properties, including TechCrunch, AOL, and Engadget.

title: Microsoft reportedly paid $100 million to make Rise of the Tomb Raider timed exclusive for Xbox
summary: New reports claim that Microsoft paid Square Enix $100 million for the one-year Xbox timed exclusivity of Rise of the Tomb Raider in 2015. This information appeared on the LinkedIn page of Square Enix's former director of strategic planning, Fabien Rossini, before being deleted. Microsoft has never officially commented on the financial terms of the deal, but the game sold over 7 million units by 2017 after the exclusivity period ended.

title: C3 AI Announces First Quarter Fiscal 2022 Results
summary: C3 AI (NYSE: AI) announced strong results for its fiscal first quarter ended July 31, 2021, with revenue up 29% year over year to $52.4 million and gross profit up 31% to $39.4 million. The company expanded its market-partner ecosystem, notably entering a strategic alliance with Google Cloud, and saw significant growth in its enterprise AI customer count and production application footprint across various industries. C3 AI also provided financial guidance for the second quarter and full fiscal year 2022, anticipating continued revenue growth.

title: Gartner Identifies Six Technologies to Drive New Customer Acquisition and Growth for Digital Marketing
summary: Gartner has identified six key technologies that digital marketers should leverage for new customer acquisition and growth in a post-pandemic world. These technologies include AI for Marketing, Multichannel Marketing Hubs, Influence Engineering, Customer Data Ethics, Event-Triggered Marketing, and Mobile Marketing Analytics. The shift from customer retention to acquisition highlights the increasing reliance on data-driven strategies and ethical considerations in marketing.

title: How to Set Up Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP with BlueXP Console
summary: This article provides a step-by-step guide on setting up Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP using the NetApp BlueXP Console. It details the process from adding a new working environment and configuring AWS IAM credentials to defining storage capacity, creating a BlueXP Console Connector, and provisioning storage volumes. The guide highlights the benefits of FSx for ONTAP, such as multiprotocol support, high availability, and integration with other AWS services, emphasizing its utility for hybrid and multicloud environments.

title: Rumor: In 2020, Sony stealthily launched new AAA studio in Japan while already planning to shut down Japan Studio
summary: A rumor suggests that Sony secretly launched a new AAA studio in Japan in 2020, even as it planned to restructure and eventually shut down Japan Studio. The new studio is reportedly focused on developing major triple-A titles for both Japanese and Western markets, and is allegedly recruiting veteran developers from companies like Capcom, Square Enix, and Konami. This move could explain Sony's CEO Jim Ryan's continued emphasis on Japan as a relevant game development hub.

title: CPR finds patched vulnerability in whatsapp could have led to data exposure of users
summary: Check Point Research (CPR) discovered a security vulnerability in WhatsApp's image filter function that could have allowed an attacker to read sensitive information from WhatsApp memory. The vulnerability, rooted in how filters were applied to specially crafted images, was reported to WhatsApp on November 10, 2020, and subsequently fixed in version 2.21.2.13. WhatsApp acknowledged the bug, designated as CVE-2020-1910, and stated that while the flaw was complex to exploit, such research helps improve user security.

title: NetApp ONTAP Storage Platform Available on AWS
summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) has launched Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, a new fully managed service that allows enterprises to utilize NetApp's ONTAP data management system in the cloud. This service enables users to access all ONTAP capabilities, features, and APIs within an AWS-managed environment, facilitating hybrid cloud strategies and simplifying data migration for on-premises ONTAP users. The offering includes two storage tiers—Primary Storage for active data and Capacity Pool Storage for infrequently accessed data—and supports various access protocols and features.

title: Interview: Expanding Global Access to the DELFI Environment
summary: This interview details Schlumberger's collaboration with IBM and Red Hat to expand global access to the DELFI cognitive E&P environment. The primary goal is to provide a hybrid cloud deployment option, overcoming restrictions in regions with data sovereignty requirements or problematic connectivity issues that prevent the use of global public clouds. This partnership aims to enable more oil and gas companies, suppliers, and partners to leverage DELFI's capabilities, fostering collaboration and workflow optimization through the Red Hat OpenShift container platform.

title: Take-Two is once again trying to kill reverse-engineered versions of GTA III and Vice City
summary: Take-Two Interactive has filed a lawsuit against the developers of re3, fan-made reverse-engineered versions of Grand Theft Auto 3 and Vice City. This legal action follows a previous attempt by the publisher to remove these projects from GitHub. Take-Two claims "irreparable harm" and focuses on the ability of re3 to run the games on platforms like the Switch and PS Vita, which the original games never supported, while developers emphasize their code is reverse-engineered and requires players to own the original games.

title: Telkom outlines three key strategies to develop its digital business
summary: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk has detailed three key strategies—build, borrow, and buy—to advance its digital business. The "build" strategy focuses on developing digital infrastructure and talent, "borrow" emphasizes strategic partnerships with technology giants like Microsoft, and "buy" involves investments in various digital companies and startups, including increased investment in Gojek and MDI Ventures. These strategies aim to drive synergy within TelkomGroup and have contributed to a 3.9 percent annual consolidated revenue growth.

title: Securing Sensitive Data Across a Distributed Endpoint Environment
summary: In an increasingly distributed work environment, IT and security teams face significant challenges in managing devices and securing sensitive data. The article highlights the worrying trend of increased sensitive data exposure on endpoints and the regulatory pressures organizations face regarding data protection. Absolute Erase is presented as a solution that enables administrators to identify, monitor, and secure sensitive files across their distributed endpoints, ensuring compliance and minimizing risk.

title: Cisco Webex Cloud Calling
summary: Webex by Cisco has achieved a record 8 billion monthly calls, supporting over 39 million cloud calling users globally, making it the leading cloud calling provider. The company has expanded its Cisco Calling Plans to include the UK, now covering over 65 countries, and introduced new innovations that offer greater flexibility and speed for enterprises migrating to cloud calling solutions. These advancements aim to unify communications for hybrid work environments, ensuring reliable and secure calling experiences embedded in daily business operations.

title: What’s Changed: 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud ERP for Product-Centric Enterprises
summary: Solutions Review highlights the key changes in the 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud ERP for Product-Centric Enterprises, analyzing the report which identifies the top 10 significant providers. The article details the Leaders (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Infor CloudSuites), Visionaries (Epicor Kinetic, Oracle NetSuite, QAD Enterprise Platform, SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Edition), and Niche Players (Acumatica, Plex, Priority Software), noting shifts like IFS's exclusion and the addition of SAP and Priority Software.

title: Microsoft acquires Clipchamp to empower creators
summary: Microsoft has acquired Clipchamp, an in-browser video creation and editing experience founded in 2013. The acquisition aims to empower creators by integrating Clipchamp's easy-to-use, powerful video editing tools into Microsoft 365, making video creation accessible for individuals, families, schools, and businesses. This move highlights video's growing importance as a communication medium across various aspects of life, from personal projects to professional documentation.

title: DC reveals details on first WEBTOON series, a FaZe Clan comic collaboration, and more for Batman Day
summary: DC has announced a host of events and releases for Batman Day on September 18th, including the debut of "Batman: Wayne Family Adventures," its first Webtoon original series. The celebrations also feature a collaboration with eSports organization FaZe Clan for an exclusive comic and the release of the scripted podcast "Batman: The Audio Adventures" on HBO Max. Additionally, DC is launching "Batman: The World," a global hardcover anthology, and offering various other comic, toy, and multimedia experiences for fans.

title: Amazon EKS Anywhere launches into general availability
summary: Amazon Web Services Inc. has announced the general availability of Amazon EKS Anywhere, an extension of its Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service. This new service allows customers to run Kubernetes clusters on-premises using VMware vSphere, providing an installable software package and automation tools for cluster lifecycle support. EKS Anywhere, similar to Google's Anthos and Microsoft's Azure Arc, is intended to simplify Kubernetes management across both cloud and on-premises environments, addressing the need for consistent management and deployment mechanisms for hybrid cloud operations.

title: Corsair partners with Ubisoft for Far Cry 6 immersive experience, AMD-powered PC giveaway
summary: Corsair is collaborating with Ubisoft for Far Cry 6, integrating its iCUE RGB lighting system directly into the game to create an immersive experience. The company is also offering copies of Far Cry 6 with qualifying iCUE product purchases and running a sweepstakes for a custom, AMD-powered Far Cry 6-themed PC. This partnership extends Corsair's previous successful integrations with Ubisoft titles, enhancing in-game actions with synchronized lighting effects.

title: El Salvador Adopts Bitcoin
summary: El Salvador has officially made Bitcoin legal tender, becoming the first nation to do so. This move aims to lower remittance costs for its large unbanked population and offer a hedge against dollar-denominated inflation, though its implementation has faced technical glitches and international criticism. The initiative, relying heavily on the Lightning Network, presents both significant opportunities for financial inclusion and economic growth, as well as considerable challenges including market volatility, geopolitical pressures, and the need for public education on cryptocurrency.

title: Former Microsoft corporate vice president Phil Sorgen joins Tola Capital as venture partner
summary: Phil Sorgen, a former Microsoft corporate vice president and chief revenue officer at RingCentral, has joined Seattle-area investment firm Tola Capital as a venture partner. Sorgen spent 24 years at Microsoft and was already connected to Tola through its Enterprise Leadership Council and a directorship at one of its portfolio companies. Tola Capital, led by former Microsoft managers, focuses on enterprise software companies and manages $440 million in assets.

title: Microsoft leases 50,000-square-foot office in Brickell
summary: Microsoft has leased a 50,000-square-foot office space in Miami's Brickell area. This move signals a growing trend of technology companies establishing a presence in South Florida. The article highlights other businesses making similar moves to the region.

title: Prevent Container Risks With Advanced Container Image Sandboxing
summary: Palo Alto Networks announced new capabilities in Prisma Cloud's Cloud Workload Protection to enhance container security, particularly through advanced machine learning for pre-deployment image sandboxing. This allows developers and DevOps teams to analyze third-party container images for dynamic threats in an isolated environment before deployment. The update also expands host security for VMs on Azure and Google Cloud, improves web application and API security, and includes Red Hat certification for its vulnerability scanner.

title: รุ่นพี่ปะทะรุ่นน้อง QQQ ETF กับ QQQJ ETF
summary: This article compares two Invesco ETFs, QQQ and QQQJ, which both track the NASDAQ-100 Index. QQQ invests in the top 100 large-cap technology companies on Nasdaq, while QQQJ (NASDAQ Next Gen 100 ETF) focuses on companies ranked 101-200. The article highlights differences in expense ratios, fund size, and investment diversification, noting that QQQJ has shown better one-year returns, while QQQ has performed better year-to-date, with QQQJ exhibiting higher volatility.

title: Introducing Michelle Reynolds, Reddit’s Chief Accounting Officer
summary: Reddit has announced the appointment of Michelle Reynolds as its first Chief Accounting Officer. Reynolds brings over 15 years of experience from Snap Inc. and other companies, and will be responsible for improving financial and accounting processes, and developing reporting practices. She will report directly to Reddit’s CFO Drew Vollero, with a focus on building a world-class financial team as the business continues to grow.

title: Lumen’s Paul Savill shares his view from the edge of the Fourth Industrial Revolution
summary: Paul Savill of Lumen Technologies discusses the strategic alliance between Lumen and Microsoft, focusing on how their combined strengths in global networking and cloud services are accelerating the Fourth Industrial Revolution. The partnership aims to provide businesses with more technology choices through edge compute nodes, enabling lower latency, cost optimization, and the development of next-generation applications. Savill highlights initiatives in smart cities, retail, and manufacturing, and envisions Lumen as a network technology company focused on moving and securing digital assets globally.

title: Will Snowflake Be Worth More Than Salesforce.com by 2030?
summary: This article analyzes whether Snowflake could surpass Salesforce.com in market capitalization by 2030, comparing their growth rates and valuations. While Snowflake projects rapid revenue growth, its current high valuation makes it unlikely to maintain its price-to-sales ratio for a decade, suggesting Salesforce will remain more valuable. However, Snowflake's stock could still offer bigger gains due to its aggressive growth targets, despite facing more competition.

title: IonQ and University of Maryland Establish First-of-Its-Kind National Quantum Lab
summary: IonQ and the University of Maryland (UMD) have partnered to create the National Quantum Lab at Maryland (Q-Lab), the nation's first user facility providing hands-on access to a commercial-grade quantum computer for the scientific community. Located in the UMD Discovery District, this initiative, part of a nearly $20 million quantum investment, aims to democratize access to quantum technology, foster innovation, and attract talent by enabling researchers and students to work with IonQ’s trapped-ion quantum computers. UMD President Darryll J. Pines and IonQ CEO Peter Chapman highlighted the significance of this collaboration in solidifying the region as a quantum capital and accelerating the commercialization of quantum computing.

title: Finding Azurescape – Cross-Account Container Takeover in Azure Container Instances
summary: Unit 42 researchers identified critical security issues in Azure Container Instances (ACI), dubbed "Azurescape," which allowed malicious users to gain full administrative control over multitenant Kubernetes clusters, enabling code execution on other users' containers and data theft. The attack exploited an old runC version for container breakout and then leveraged either a privileged Kubernetes service account token or an SSRF vulnerability in the 'bridge' pod to escalate privileges to cluster admin. Microsoft has since patched both reported vulnerabilities to prevent such cross-account takeovers.

title: The Top 8 Security and Risk Trends We’re Watching
summary: Gartner identifies eight top security and risk trends for 2021, driven by factors like security breaches and the COVID-19 pandemic. These trends highlight strategic shifts in the security ecosystem, including cybersecurity mesh, cyber-savvy boards, vendor consolidation, and identity-first security, emphasizing the need for flexible and agile security solutions. The report also addresses the rising importance of managing machine identities, the permanence of remote work, breach and attack simulation, and privacy-enhancing computation techniques.

title: The effects of remote work on collaboration among information workers
summary: A study using data from 61,182 US Microsoft employees explores the causal effects of firm-wide remote work on collaboration and communication during the first six months of 2020. The findings indicate that remote work led to a more static and siloed collaboration network with fewer cross-group connections, as well as a decrease in synchronous communication and an increase in asynchronous communication. These changes may hinder employees' ability to acquire and share new information across the organization.

title: Single Stocks & ETFs Do Mix
summary: This article discusses how single stocks and ETFs can both have a place in an investment portfolio. It highlights the similarities and differences, emphasizing the importance of considering overall portfolio concentration when adding individual stocks. The author also weighs the pros and cons, such as lower costs for single stocks versus the diversification and professional management benefits of ETFs.

title: How Navi's FoF on Vanguard US Total Stock Market ETF could add value to your portfolio
summary: Navi Mutual Fund has filed for a new Fund of Fund (FoF) that will invest in the Vanguard Total Stock Market Index Fund ETF (VTI), a passively managed US-based ETF with a very low expense ratio. This FoF will allow Indian investors to access the broad US equity market, including companies typically unavailable in India, potentially adding value due to low correlation with the Indian market. However, investors should be aware of debt fund taxation rules for international funds.

title: Microsoft to Open Regional Hub, Latin American Offices in Miami
summary: Microsoft is establishing a new regional hub and Latin American offices in Miami, leasing approximately 42,000 square feet at 830 Brickell. This new location will serve as headquarters for Microsoft Latin America and aims to deepen relationships with customers while supporting collaboration and productivity among employees. The regional hub is anticipated to open in mid-2023.

title: C3 AI Announces General Availability of C3 AI CRM
summary: C3 AI (NYSE:AI) announced the general availability of C3 AI CRM, which integrates AI capabilities with existing CRM systems like Microsoft Dynamics and Salesforce. This new offering aims to reinvent CRM by providing AI-powered insights, predictive forecasting, customer retention tools, and enhanced visualizations to drive revenue and customer satisfaction. The platform offers capabilities such as AI Sales Vision, AI Market Vision, and AI Customer Vision, and is immediately available on major cloud platforms.

title: Copado Hits Unicorn Valuation After $140M Raise Led by Insight Partners
summary: Chicago-based tech startup Copado has achieved a unicorn valuation after securing $140 million in Series C funding led by Insight Partners. This new capital will be used to expand its multi-cloud DevOps platform, specifically supporting additional cloud platforms beyond Salesforce and fueling international growth, particularly in Asia. The company experienced rapid growth, reaching 500 global employees and adding major brands to its 1,100+ customer base, highlighting the increasing strategic importance of DevOps for digital transformation.

title: Microsoft creates an R&D hub in Spain focused on Artificial Intelligence models to improve user experience
summary: Microsoft has established a new R&D hub in Barcelona, Spain, dedicated to developing Artificial Intelligence models to enhance user experience on the web. This hub is part of Microsoft's WebXT division and aims to attract top talent from across Europe, initially employing 30 professionals with plans to expand to over 100. It will focus on areas like growth and engagement for Bing, local search experiences, core search and AI, and whole page optimization.

title: Cloudflare Workers: the Fast Serverless Platform
summary: This article discusses Cloudflare Workers, a serverless platform designed for speed and efficiency at the edge. It highlights how Workers significantly outperform other serverless offerings like Lambda and Lambda@Edge in terms of speed and addresses the challenges posed by traditional container-based serverless architectures by leveraging lightweight V8 isolates. The post emphasizes that Workers' architecture eliminates cold starts and provides a better developer and end-user experience due to its global edge network and continuous performance improvements.

title: Gartner® Recognizes Microsoft as a Leader in the 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Cloud ERP for Product-Centric Enterprises
summary: Microsoft has been recognized as a Leader in the 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud ERP for Product-Centric Enterprises due to its Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management and Dynamics 365 Finance solutions. These offerings provide composable ERP capabilities, enabling product-centric enterprises to transform their systems by moving to the cloud, improving agility, and leveraging AI-based predictive insights. Recent investments, including the acquisition of Suplari and the general availability of Dynamics 365 Intelligent Order Management, further enhance Microsoft's commitment to delivering advanced ERP solutions.

title: Customize Your Spartan Faster Thanks to Double XP With Purchase of Kellogg's® Products For Halo Infinite
summary: Kellogg's, in partnership with Halo, is offering Double XP in Halo Infinite Multiplayer to fans who purchase select Kellogg's snack products including Pringles, Cheez-It Grooves, Pop-Tarts, and Bear Naked. This promotion runs from September 15, 2021, to January 31, 2022, allowing gamers to earn in-game rewards by uploading receipts. The initiative aims to enhance the player experience for the upcoming Halo Infinite launch on December 8.

title: Palo Alto Networks’s new Prisma SASE offers integrated cloud-delivered service
summary: Palo Alto Networks Inc. announced Prisma SASE, a new integrated cloud-delivered service combining network security (SASE) and software-defined wide-area networking (SD-WAN). The product aims to enhance security and productivity for organizations by integrating 5G, Autonomous Digital Experience Management (ADEM), and various cloud services through CloudBlades. It offers a simplified approach to adopting SASE with integrated web security rules and capabilities for a hybrid workforce.

title: The Faculty of Engineering and Technology at Melbourne Connect
summary: This article details AECOM's involvement in designing the new 15,000m² workspace for the Faculty of Engineering and Information Technology (FEIT) at Melbourne Connect. The project focused on integrating academic, research, and industry activities, including specialized labs like the Telstra Creator Space and HCI/Usability Labs. AECOM provided a range of design and engineering services, emphasizing collaboration, advanced technology integration, and acoustic design for a cutting-edge academic environment.

title: E-signature platforms strengthen document management's clout
summary: E-signature platforms are emerging as a critical component of automated document management systems, driven by digital transformation and accelerated by the COVID-19 pandemic. They streamline workflows, reduce costs, improve efficiency, and enhance customer and employee experiences compared to traditional paper-based processes. The article highlights the differences between digital and electronic signatures and discusses the expanding role of e-signatures within enterprise applications, emphasizing the benefits of an enterprise-wide approach and integration with other platforms like Microsoft Teams and Salesforce.

title: The rise of the customer innovation center
summary: Customer innovation centers (CICs) are evolving from traditional customer experience centers (CECs) to provide more experiential and memorable B2B engagements, addressing the historical lag in B2B customer experience compared to B2C. These new CICs focus on building brand identity, generating excitement through storytelling, reimagining the "new office" for hybrid workforces, and embedding constant change through accessible communication ecosystems. With the incorporation of hybrid compatibility and AI-experience curation, CICs are poised to become a critical component of experiential marketing, pushing creativity and connectivity for brands.

title: 12 Best Virtual Conference Platforms
summary: This article reviews the 12 best virtual conference platforms, explaining what each offers and highlighting their unique features, costs, and ideal use cases. It covers a range of platforms from general business solutions like Zoom and Microsoft Teams to specialized event tools like Big Marker and Convene Studio, catering to various event sizes and needs. The piece emphasizes the continued importance of virtual events even after the 2020 pandemic.

title: Akerna expands ERP portfolio with $17 million acquisition of Microsoft ISV 365 Cannabis
summary: Akerna, an enterprise software company for the cannabis industry, has announced the acquisition of Microsoft ISV 365 Cannabis for $17 million in cash and stock, with an additional $8 million in earnouts. This acquisition will expand Akerna's ERP portfolio by adding a solution built on Dynamics 365 Business Central, offering clients more choices for financial and tax planning systems. 365 Cannabis, with over 85 clients and $8.2 million in LTM revenue, provides an ERP solution tailored for the cannabis industry, covering cultivation, compliance, retail, and more.

title: GINN Has Goods for Tech Bulls
summary: The Goldman Sachs Innovate Equity ETF (GINN) offers tech exposure with a focus on disruptive growth, allocating 33.4% to tech stocks. Goldman Sachs analysts are bullish on software names, including Microsoft, Adobe, and Salesforce, all of which are GINN holdings. Additionally, GINN stands to benefit from potential rebounds in fintech, consumer discretionary, and healthcare sectors, and strong performance from mega-cap internet stocks like Alphabet and Facebook.

title: HP launches new device management tools for hybrid work
summary: HP has introduced new cloud-based device management solutions designed to enhance IT productivity and employee experience for hybrid work environments. These solutions include HP Adaptive Endpoint Management, HP Connect for Microsoft Endpoint Manager, and HP Cloud Endpoint Manager, aiming to simplify and automate device setup, management, and security, especially for remote employees. HP emphasizes that these tools empower IT teams to focus on strategic initiatives by minimizing day-to-day PC management tasks.

title: Wells Fargo picks Microsoft, Google as cloud service providers
summary: Wells Fargo & Co has selected Microsoft Corp's Azure as its primary cloud provider and Google Cloud for additional business-critical services, adopting a multi-cloud strategy. This move aligns with the bank's new digital infrastructure strategy, which involves transitioning to third-party data centers and relying more on public cloud services in the long term. Wells Fargo is the latest major bank to adopt such an approach, which offers flexibility and helps reduce the significant costs associated with operating proprietary data centers.

title: C3 AI Reinvents Enterprise Software UX with C3 AI Data Vision
summary: C3 AI announced the launch of C3 AI Data Vision, an AI-powered knowledge graph and insight capability designed to fundamentally change the user experience of enterprise software. This new product enables near real-time investigation and collaborative data analysis through interactive, intuitive graph network visualizations, moving beyond traditional static lists and forms. It allows organizations to visualize data interdependencies, accelerate investigations, and attain new insights more effectively from disparate data sources, machine learning models, and processes.

title: Columbia Sportswear CEO visits White House for meeting on Biden's vaccine mandate
summary: Columbia Sportswear CEO Tim Boyle attended a White House meeting with President Biden and other business leaders to discuss the president's vaccine mandate for large employers. Boyle, a strong supporter of the mandate, stated it would help level the playing field for hiring and employee retention. Columbia Sportswear, with 4,000 U.S. employees, plans to require vaccinations for its workers.

title: HPE finds second new CTO in 16 months with Fidelma Russo
summary: HPE has appointed Fidelma Russo, formerly of VMware, as its new Chief Technology Officer, marking the second CTO change in 16 months. Russo's extensive background in cloud services, software, and infrastructure is expected to drive innovation for HPE's GreenLake edge-to-cloud platform. This move signals HPE's strategic shift towards cloud-centric solutions to compete with off-premises rivals, despite strong Q3 financials attributed partly to increased hardware prices.

title: FDIC teams up with Microsoft and Truist to create fund to invest in minority-owned banks
summary: The FDIC, in collaboration with Microsoft and Truist Financial, is launching a new Mission-Driven Bank Fund to channel much-needed capital to banks that serve minority, lower-income, and rural communities. This initiative aims to support minority-owned institutions, which often struggle with long-term capital access. The fund has already raised approximately $120 million, with Microsoft and Truist as anchor investors, and seeks to leverage investments to boost homeownership and small business formation in underserved communities.

title: Microsoft collaborates with AICTE, NASSCOM, EY, GitHub, and Quess Corp to empower India’s youth with tech skills to be job-ready
summary: Microsoft, in collaboration with AICTE, NASSCOM, EY, GitHub, and Quess Corp, has launched the "Future Ready Talent" program in India. This initiative aims to skill over 1.5 lakh higher education students in areas like data and AI, cloud computing, and cybersecurity to enhance their employability. The program provides a comprehensive platform from digital skilling and project work to mentorship and access to potential employers.

title: How an ERP System Helped a Medical Device Manufacturer Meet Customer Demands
summary: This article details how Insulet Corporation, a medical device manufacturer, successfully upgraded its ERP system to meet increased customer demand and overcome regulatory challenges. By partnering with Alithya and implementing a new Microsoft Dynamics AX system, Insulet expanded into European markets, opened a new manufacturing facility, and scaled its operations. The upgrade provided crucial supply chain and manufacturing functionality while remaining within budget and timeline constraints.

title: How Manufacturers can Ease into the Industry 4.0 Waters
summary: This article outlines a three-step approach for manufacturers to successfully adopt Industry 4.0 technologies. It emphasizes considering key business drivers, integrating people, processes, technology, and data, and adopting an agile approach to implementation. By focusing on these areas, manufacturers can optimize operations, boost profitability, and achieve a strategic digital transformation.

title: Elastic Announces ElasticON Global Virtual Conference, Oct. 5 - 7, 2021
summary: Elastic announced details for its free, virtual ElasticON Global conference, scheduled for October 5-7, 2021. The event, themed "Solve," will feature keynotes from Elastic's CEO Shay Banon and CPO Ashutosh Kulkarni, as well as fireside chats with Microsoft EVP Scott Guthrie, chef José Andrés, and NASA's Diana Trujillo. The conference will also include over 100 technical sessions, a virtual exhibit hall, and opportunities for participants to enhance their skills with live training courses.

title: Microsoft (MSFT) Board Approves $60B Share Repurchase Program
summary: Microsoft's board has approved a new $60 billion share repurchase program and increased its quarterly dividend by 11% to 62 cents per share. This move follows a series of similar buyback programs initiated by the company over the past decade, with the latest coming as a previous $40 billion program is nearing its completion. The announcement is particularly noteworthy given recent efforts by Democrats to impose a tax on corporate stock buybacks, a practice that critics argue can artificially inflate stock prices and EPS.

title: Threat Brief: OMI Vulnerabilities (CVE-2021-38645, CVE-2021-38647, CVE-2021-38648 and CVE-2021-38649)
summary: This threat brief details four critical vulnerabilities, collectively dubbed OMIGOD, affecting Microsoft Azure's Open Management Infrastructure (OMI) package. Discovered by Wiz and patched on September 14, 2021, these vulnerabilities include one unauthenticated remote code execution and three privilege escalation issues. The article provides information on affected Azure services, custom detection rules for Prisma Cloud users, and remediation steps for vulnerable systems.

title: Mat Bisher Joins DDB New York as Chief Creative Officer, Further Fueling the Power of Creativity within the New York Office
summary: DDB has announced the appointment of Mat Bisher as Chief Creative Officer for DDB NY. Bisher, who has over 24 years of creative experience and a background with agencies like McCann and BBDO, will lead the creative teams at DDB's flagship office under the guidance of DDB Global CCO Ari Weiss. His work has received numerous awards, and he is recognized for his influential creative leadership.

title: Using Infrastructure as Code to deploy F5 Application Delivery and Cisco ACI Service Chaining
summary: This article discusses how Cisco and F5 have partnered to simplify the deployment of L4-L7 services using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with HashiCorp Terraform. It highlights the use of Terraform modules to automate the configuration of Cisco ACI network infrastructure and F5 BIG-IP L4-L7 services, improving efficiency and reducing errors in application deployment. The solution aims to accelerate the application deployment lifecycle and achieve better time to value.

title: Is a stock market correction on the horizon?
summary: The S&P 500 has seen a recent dip, leading analysts to narrow predictions for the U.S. equity market. While tech stocks may face challenges due to Fed policy and rising interest rates, other sectors like energy and small-caps are showing potential. Despite concerns, corrections are normal, and many analysts remain bullish on long-term market growth, suggesting current dips could be buying opportunities.

title: Wells Fargo cloud plans revealed amid sweeping IT overhaul
summary: Wells Fargo has unveiled a new multi-cloud infrastructure strategy, selecting Azure as its primary public cloud provider and Google Cloud for AI solutions, alongside existing HPE GreenLake contracts. This move is part of a sweeping IT overhaul aimed at driving technological speed, agility, and scalability, as well as addressing risk and compliance issues following a major scandal. The bank plans a hybrid approach, initially utilizing third-party data centers while aspiring to predominantly rely on public cloud offerings.

title: Bill Gates secures hundreds of millions from U.S. firms for climate fight
summary: Bill Gates' non-profit, Breakthrough Energy, has secured investments from major U.S. companies like Microsoft, BlackRock, and General Motors to fund its "Breakthrough Energy Catalyst" project. This initiative aims to finance, produce, and buy new solutions crucial for a zero-carbon economy, with an initial focus on technologies such as direct air capture, green hydrogen, and sustainable aviation fuel. Gates emphasized that a "new industrial revolution" is necessary to avert a climate disaster, as much of the needed clean technology is either undeveloped or too expensive.

title: Recruiting AI systems under fire for excluding workers
summary: AI-powered recruiting systems are facing increasing scrutiny for embedded biases that exclude qualified candidates, prioritizing efficiency over efficacy. A Harvard Business School and Accenture study, "Hidden Workers: Untapped Talent," highlights how these systems disproportionately harm veterans, immigrants, people with disabilities, and previously incarcerated individuals. The United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights has called for a broad moratorium on AI use, including recruiting systems, urging a pause until human rights abuses can be identified and mitigated.

title: Adaptive Biotechnologies’ new HQ: Co-founders show off 100K square-foot space in Seattle
summary: Adaptive Biotechnologies is opening a new 100,000 square-foot headquarters in Seattle's South Lake Union neighborhood after doubling its workforce during the pandemic. The new facility, which includes 20,000 square feet of lab space, was designed to optimize efficiency and foster collaboration. Co-founders Chad and Harlan Robins emphasized the building's modularity and its focus on T-cell research, a core area for the company's COVID-19 and other disease diagnostics and therapies.

title: รีวิวกองทุน SCBKEQTG: หุ้นเกาหลีกับศักยภาพการเป็นแถวหน้าของเอเชีย
summary: บทความนี้รีวิวกองทุน SCBKEQTG ซึ่งลงทุนในหุ้นเกาหลีใต้ โดยเน้นศักยภาพทางเศรษฐกิจของประเทศจากเทคโนโลยี การส่งออก และบริษัทชั้นนำ นอกจากนี้ยังอธิบายโครงสร้างของดัชนี MSCI Korea 25/50 ที่กองทุนใช้อ้างอิง และแนะนำ 10 อันดับแรกของหุ้นที่กองทุนลงทุน ซึ่งรวมถึง Samsung Electronics และ SK Hynix ที่เป็นผู้นำด้านเทคโนโลยีระดับโลก

title: Trash Talk: Startup’s AI-Driven Detection System Primed to Take a Bite Out of Global Waste
summary: Recycleye, a London-based computer vision startup, is leveraging AI to significantly boost global recycling rates. By automating and enhancing the precision of waste material identification, their system aims to increase the capacity for recycling companies and improve overall recovery rates. The company, part of the NVIDIA Inception accelerator program, has successfully partnered with major waste management firms and energy leaders, developing tools like the WasteNet database and using NVIDIA's Deep Learning SDKs to achieve accuracy exceeding human vision in waste sorting.

title: How cloud-native tech will impact 5G mobile networks
summary: Yaniv Hoffman of Radware discusses how cloud-native technology is transforming 5G mobile networks for Communication Service Providers (CSPs) in the Asia Pacific region. While offering benefits like reduced capital and operating expenditures and enabling new services, this shift introduces significant security challenges due to the distributed, microservices-based architecture of 5G. CSPs must adopt automated, scalable security solutions to protect against diverse threats arising from network slicing, edge computing, and increased exposure.

title: Rackspace Launches Rackspace Data Freedom to Eliminate Cloud Lock-In
summary: Rackspace Technology has introduced Rackspace Data Freedom, a new platform designed to help organizations avoid cloud lock-in by separating storage from public cloud compute. This service aims to eliminate unpredictable data egress charges, allowing customers to save on costs and maintain data sovereignty across multi-cloud environments. Key benefits include significant cost reduction through Rackspace's private network, enhanced data accessibility via RackConnect Global, and customized storage solutions to meet specific user requirements.

title: FDIC Recruits Microsoft & Truist to Build a Fund for Minority-Owned Banks
summary: The FDIC is launching a new "Mission-Driven Bank Fund" with initial investments totaling $120 million from anchor investors Microsoft and Truist, as well as founding investor Discovery Inc. This fund aims to inject capital into minority depository institutions (MDIs) and community development financial institutions (CDFIs) to help them increase lending in underserved communities impacted by the pandemic. FDIC Chair Jelena McWilliams initiated the idea, inspired by "Shark Tank," and consulted with MDI and CDFI CEOs to shape the fund, which will be advisory-only from the FDIC's side.

title: Inside Wells Fargo’s multicloud strategy
summary: Wells Fargo is implementing a decade-long multicloud strategy, partnering with Microsoft and Google to modernize its technology infrastructure for public cloud operations. This approach, while different from some competitors, aims for portability, resilience, and avoids vendor lock-in, addressing the challenges of migrating highly regulated data and upskilling its workforce. The financial institution plans to progressively move existing applications to the public cloud, prioritizing impact over speed, with the ultimate goal of moving away from traditional data centers.

title: CIBC Unveils New Logo
summary: CIBC, Canada's fifth-largest bank, has launched a new brand image featuring two chevrons to symbolize its past, future, and client relationships. The new logo reimagines its 1966 original and will appear across digital channels and ads on September 23, with physical banking products updated in the coming year. Analysts maintain a Strong Buy rating for CIBC, citing its performance in mortgages and commercial lending, with an implied upside potential of 12.3%.

title: The Market Remains Hot As We Kick Off Our Next Forrester Wave™ Evaluation Of The DAM Landscape
summary: Forrester is launching its next Wave evaluation for Digital Asset Management (DAM) due to significant market growth and increasing customer demand. Many organizations struggle with content creation challenges, such as outdated processes, content volume outpacing production capabilities, and the need for better personalization foundations. DAM solutions offer governance, centralization, metadata enrichment, content atomization, and AI-powered tagging, distinguishing them from basic cloud storage options.

title: Inside Wells Fargo's multicloud strategy
summary: Wells Fargo is embarking on a decade-long initiative to modernize its technology infrastructure by implementing a multicloud strategy, collaborating with Microsoft as its primary public cloud provider and Google Cloud for advanced workloads like AI. This approach contrasts with other major financial institutions that often align with a single cloud provider, emphasizing portability and vendor agnosticism. The bank aims to migrate most existing applications to the public cloud within the first five years, simultaneously upskilling its workforce to meet new technological demands and gradually moving away from traditional data centers while preserving resilience and disaster recovery capabilities.

title: Salesforce Launches Updated Sustainability Cloud Integrating Newly Acquired Slack, as Company Achieves Net Zero
summary: Salesforce announced it has achieved net zero emissions across its full value chain and 100% renewable energy for its operations. The company also launched Sustainability Cloud 2.0, which now integrates Slack for enhanced collaboration, to help organizations track and reduce carbon emissions. This updated platform comes alongside Salesforce's climate action plan and advocacy for mandatory climate reporting.

title: The 4 Trends That Prevail on the Gartner Hype Cycle for AI, 2021
summary: This article outlines the four major trends dominating the Gartner Hype Cycle for AI in 2021: operationalizing AI initiatives, efficient use of data, models, and compute, responsible AI, and data for AI. It emphasizes the need for organizations to move AI proofs of concept into production faster, leverage composite and generative AI, ensure ethical and transparent AI systems, and adapt to "small data" and "wide data" approaches due to disruptions like the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: Cisco Named a Leader in 2021 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for WAN Edge Infrastructure
summary: Cisco has announced its recognition as a Leader in the 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant for WAN Edge Infrastructure, highlighting its SD-WAN solutions. These solutions focus on enabling secure, predictable digital experiences for hybrid workforces, building dynamic workspaces, and securing multi-cloud environments, accelerating the transition to a SASE-enabled architecture. Cisco emphasizes its comprehensive capabilities in seamless multicloud access, integrated security, and optimized insights through ThousandEyes integration.

title: Indian SaaS start-up Freshworks lists on Nasdaq following billion-dollar IPO
summary: Indian SaaS start-up Freshworks, founded as Freshdesk in 2010, has officially listed on Nasdaq after an initial public offering (IPO) exceeding $1 billion, becoming the first Indian SaaS company and unicorn to do so. The Chennai and San Mateo-based company, which offers IT, customer services, sales, marketing, and HR solutions, saw its share price surge 33% to $48 in initial trade under the ticker "$FRSH". Co-founder and CEO Girish Mathrubootham expressed immense pride and likened the achievement to Roger Bannister breaking the four-minute mile, anticipating more Indian companies to follow suit.

title: If You Missed the PS5 Restock, Here’s How to Prepare for the Next One
summary: This article discusses the ongoing PS5 stock shortages, nearly a year after its release, exacerbated by the pandemic and chip shortages. It offers tips for securing a console during future restocks, such as signing up for retailer accounts with current billing/shipping info, avoiding PayPal for faster checkout, and following Twitter alert accounts like @PS5StockAlerts, @mattswider, and @Wario64. The piece highlights that despite recent rumors of a major restock, consoles quickly sold out.

title: How to use virtual whiteboards on Zoom and Microsoft Teams
summary: This article explains how to utilize virtual whiteboards within Zoom and Microsoft Teams meetings to enhance collaboration. It details the common tools and features available in both platforms, such as pens, highlighters, text boxes, and saving capabilities, and highlights unique features like sticky notes in Teams and a spotlight tool in Zoom. The piece encourages users to practice using these simple yet effective tools to add clarity to their virtual team meetings.

title: The Financial Services Data Revolution at Wells Fargo & JP Morgan
summary: Banks and financial services companies are rapidly adopting cloud-based data management solutions to modernize their operations and enhance customer experiences. Wells Fargo has partnered with Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud for its digital infrastructure, while JP Morgan Chase is leveraging AWS for a large-scale modernization effort. Snowflake has also introduced a Financial Services Data Cloud, highlighting a trend towards industry-specific cloud platforms.

title: Papa Johns Opening Headquarters in Atlanta
summary: Papa John's International is relocating its headquarters for commercial, communications, development, operations, people operations, and Diversity, Equity and Inclusion teams to Atlanta. The Louisville-based pizza company will occupy the top two floors of Three Ballpark Center at The Battery, totaling 60,000 square feet, and expects to house 190 employees in the new location. This move follows Papa John's announcement last September about establishing a corporate office in Atlanta, joining other major companies in the area.

title: Modi, Qualcomm CEO discuss semiconductor
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met with Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon in the US to discuss investment opportunities in India's telecom and electronics sectors, particularly focusing on the semiconductor supply chain and the government's production-linked incentive schemes. This meeting was Modi's first engagement upon his arrival in the US, highlighting India's push to attract semiconductor companies and build a local innovation ecosystem. Modi also met with top officials from Adobe, First Solar, General Atomics Global Corporation, and Blackstone to discuss various investment and collaboration opportunities in India.

title: Microsoft, Sabic collaborate on Ocean Plastic Mouse
summary: Microsoft has launched a new computer mouse that incorporates 20% ocean plastic, a result of its collaboration with Sabic. This initiative highlights efforts in the plastics industry to utilize recycled materials. The article also mentions various updates and features from Plastics News, including a chemical recycling tracker and awards for processors.

title: RIM delays new BlackBerry launch; sales crumble
summary: Research In Motion Ltd (RIM) has delayed the launch of its next-generation BlackBerry phones until early 2013, a significant setback for the company facing crumbling sales, a deeper-than-expected quarterly operating loss, and deep job cuts. The delay, coupled with a 30% workforce reduction and mounting financial pressure, signals a potential terminal decline for the once-dominant technology firm. Analysts are concerned about RIM's survival as it misses crucial shopping periods and struggles to compete with Apple and Android.

title: Marketing Resource Management Market Size, Share, Growth, Forecast, 2034
summary: The global Marketing Resource Management (MRM) market was valued at USD 5.61 billion in 2025 and is projected to grow to USD 16.28 billion by 2034, exhibiting a CAGR of 12.57% during the forecast period. This growth is driven by the increasing need for brand and regulatory compliance and the adoption of cloud-based MRM services, despite challenges like cyber-attacks. North America currently holds the largest market share due to the presence of major players and rapid cloud adoption, while Asia Pacific is expected to show significant growth due to digitization and the rising adoption of SaaS and cloud solutions by SMEs.

title: Windows 11 is coming. Here’s what you need to know about updates and upgrades
summary: Microsoft Corporation announced that Windows 11 is set to release on October 5, featuring an upgraded UI, improved widgets, and optimizations for various hardware. While new eligible devices will receive the upgrade first, users with older hardware may need to upgrade their systems to meet the higher requirements. Windows 10 support will continue until October 14, 2025, offering users ample time to transition.

title: Digital Turbine Stock, Builders FirstSource, Cricut Among 19 New IBD Watchlist Stocks
summary: Investor's Business Daily (IBD) has added Digital Turbine, Builders FirstSource, and Cricut to its updated watchlist, which includes 19 new stocks. IBD regularly updates its stock screens, such as the IBD 50 and IBD Sector Leaders, to help investors identify promising stocks, and the article provides a detailed list of these additions and removals.

title: Microsoft Surface headphones 2 – a strong premium competitor (review)
summary: The Microsoft Surface Headphones 2 are reviewed as a strong premium competitor, offering incremental updates over their predecessor, including Bluetooth 5.0 and Qualcomm aptX codec. Priced at $399.95, they feature intuitive controls, significantly improved bass response, and decent noise cancellation, positioning them well against leading brands like Sony and Bose. The review highlights their value, sound quality, and unique features, recommending them for users prioritizing aptX compatibility.

title: Boosting HR Efficiencies through Artificial Intelligence
summary: Wipro's HR Shared Services (HRSS), serving over 200,000 employees globally, faced challenges with high data volumes and process variations leading to delays. To address this, Wipro utilized its AI Solutions team and the Holmes augmented intelligence platform to automate various HR processes, including background verification, insurance enrollment, and payroll. This AI-driven solution resulted in significant operational savings, reduced turnaround times, and improved the employee experience by freeing HR teams to focus on strategic tasks.

title: Why Intuit Paid $500 Million for Naming Rights at Clippers Arena
summary: Intuit paid $500 million for the naming rights to the Los Angeles Clippers' new 18,000-seat arena, the Intuit Dome, for 23 years. This deal is part of a broader partnership focusing on fan experience, technology, and community involvement in Inglewood. The agreement aims to boost Intuit's public profile and contribute to the economic development and job creation in the area.

title: Microsoft is a Leader in the 2021 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Enterprise Low-Code Application Platforms
summary: Microsoft has been recognized as a Leader in the 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Enterprise Low-Code Application Platforms for its Power Apps product. The article highlights how Microsoft has invested significantly in making its Power Platform the most comprehensive low-code application development platform, used by 92% of Fortune 500 organizations. It outlines five key reasons for Power Apps' leadership, including its trusted cloud infrastructure, support for fusion teams, enterprise reliability, superior innovation, and design for all developers.

title: What Is Blockchain?
summary: This article defines blockchain as a decentralized ledger of shared data, explaining how its cryptographic hashes and peer-to-peer network ensure data integrity, security, and immutability. It details the three main types of blockchain—public, private, and federated—and highlights the significant business benefits, including establishing trust, streamlining operations, and improving security, particularly when integrated with technologies like IoT and AI. The article also introduces Hyperledger as a key open-source initiative promoting enterprise blockchain solutions.

title: Korean MZers become world's biggest spenders on mobile games
summary: South Korean millennials and Gen Zers (MZers) have become the world's leading spenders on mobile games, with a monthly average of $13 per person in the first half of the year. This demographic accounts for over 90% of domestic mobile game users. Most of their expenditure is on domestic games, followed by titles from China and Japan.

title: Newmark Announces Sale of 200-Unit Multifamily Property Adjacent to Austin, Texas’ ‘Second Downtown’
summary: Newmark announced the sale of Northstar Apartments, a 200-unit multifamily property in Austin, Texas, located near "The Domain" and Apple's new campus. The property was sold by Nitya Capital to Langdon Street Capital, which plans further investment in the Austin market. The sale highlights the strong growth in Austin's multifamily capital markets, with significant sales volume driven by the tech employment cluster.

title: Capitalizing on the many artificial neural network uses
summary: This article explores the expanding uses of artificial neural networks (ANNs) in enterprises, highlighting their potential benefits despite challenges like ethical concerns and implementation complexities. It differentiates between convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for spatial data and recurrent neural networks (RNNs) for sequential data, providing examples such as facial recognition, medical analysis, fraud detection, and customer habit monitoring. The article also discusses crucial considerations for businesses, including addressing transparency issues, managing computational resources, and defining clear value statements before deployment.

title: Western States Caterpillar – fusion teams use Microsoft Power Platform to build mobile apps for field staff
summary: Western States Caterpillar leveraged Microsoft Power Platform to build mobile apps for field staff, specifically addressing the digitization of rental returns and enabling sales teams to better understand customers. This initiative involved a "fusion team" approach, combining low-code (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) and pro-dev technologies (ASP.NET Core, Azure Blob storage, Azure SQL), resulting in significant improvements in operational efficiency and sales effectiveness. The success of these solutions, "Return to Ready" and "Client Connect," has led to substantial growth in Power BI and Power Apps usage across the company, inspiring other Caterpillar dealers.

title: Specifications of Personal Computers Over Time
summary: This article traces the evolution of personal computer specifications over 50 years, from the 1971 Kenbak-1 to modern HP Pavilion models. It highlights significant advancements in RAM and processing speed, and discusses key PC specifications like processor speed and RAM, explaining their importance and upgradeability. An infographic details spec changes for popular computers through the years.

title: Warby Parker opens at $54.05 per share in public debut on NYSE, soaring more than 30% above reference price
summary: Eyewear company Warby Parker made its public debut on the NYSE via a direct listing, with its stock, WRBY, opening at $54.05 per share, significantly above its $40 reference price. The company, valued at over $6 billion after its first day of trading, aims to expand its market share in eyeglasses, contact lenses, and eye exams, despite recent losses, through continued physical retail growth and its strong digital presence. Co-CEOs Dave Gilboa and Neil Blumenthal see massive growth opportunities in its various categories.

title: Norfolk Southern's former Midtown HQ lands big tenant; upgrades pending
summary: Visa plans to open a new Midtown Atlanta office, projected to house 1,000 employees focusing on tech and client services, in the former Norfolk Southern headquarters. This move marks another significant tech-job win for Midtown, following announcements from Google and Microsoft. Cousins Properties, which owns the building, will undertake substantial renovations after Norfolk Southern vacates later this year.

title: Cathie Wood’s Ark Investment sells $270M worth of Tesla stake
summary: Cathie Wood’s Ark Investment Management sold over 340,000 shares of Tesla, worth nearly $270 million, across three of its exchange-traded funds. This move comes as a bond selloff impacted rate-sensitive technology stocks, leading to outflows from Ark's growth-focused funds. Despite the sale, Tesla remains Ark's largest holding, with Wood predicting its shares will reach $3,000.

title: Billionaire Orlando Bravo Owns Bitcoin And Is Very Bullish
summary: Billionaire Orlando Bravo, cofounder of private equity firm Thoma Bravo, has publicly stated his personal investment in Bitcoin and his bullish outlook on its future. He believes that increasing institutional adoption will significantly drive up Bitcoin's value in the coming years. Thoma Bravo, with over $83 billion in assets, recently participated in a funding round for the Bitcoin exchange FTX.

title: 8 Big New Revelations About IBM’s Kyndryl Spin-Off
summary: A new regulatory filing by Kyndryl, IBM's managed infrastructure unit, reveals crucial details as it prepares for independence. The filing highlights Kyndryl's declining revenue over several years, significant net losses, workforce reductions, and the intense competitive landscape it faces. Despite these challenges, Kyndryl aims to capitalize on a $415 billion market for IT services and plans to expand partnerships beyond IBM with companies like VMware and Microsoft.

title: Microsoft’s million-tonne CO2-removal purchase — lessons for net zero
summary: Microsoft announced in January 2021 that it had purchased the removal of 1.3 million tonnes of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere as part of its commitment to achieve net-zero emissions by 2030 and become carbon negative by 2050. The purchases include forest expansion and soil regeneration projects, as well as direct air capture technology. This initiative, along with similar efforts by Stripe, highlights challenges in achieving net-zero goals, including inconsistent definitions, poor carbon accounting, and an immature carbon removal market, which need to be addressed to meet mid-century climate goals.

title: GC Profile: Noralee Bradley supports global food supply and ESG priorities at Nutrien
summary: Noralee Bradley, Executive Vice President and Chief Legal Officer at Nutrien, returned to her Saskatchewan roots to join the global fertilizer giant in March 2020. She immediately navigated the company through the COVID-19 pandemic, ensuring employee safety and operational continuity as an essential service. Bradley is also instrumental in leading Nutrien's "Feeding the Future" plan, incorporating ESG commitments, and is focused on building the "legal department of the future" by enhancing integrity programs and optimizing the team's professional development.

title: Zoom and Five9 abandon $14.7 billion acquisition
summary: Zoom and Five9 have called off their $14.7 billion all-stock acquisition after Five9 shareholders rejected the deal and regulators raised concerns about foreign participation. This marks a missed opportunity for Zoom to quickly expand its capabilities following its pandemic-driven growth, and Five9 shareholders were reportedly unsatisfied with the premium offered. Despite the termination, both companies plan to maintain their existing product partnership.

title: What’s Changed: 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant for IT Risk Management
summary: This article discusses the key changes and findings in the 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant for IT Risk Management. It highlights the growing market for ITRM products due to increased focus on cybersecurity and compliance, the shift towards cloud-first and SaaS offerings, and Gartner's predictions for the future integration of machine learning capabilities. The report evaluates 14 vendors, categorizing them into leaders, challengers, and niche players, and details the strengths of top performers like ServiceNow, Diligent, and Archer.

title: Real-Time Communications at Scale
summary: Cloudflare is introducing its Real-Time Communications platform, a new suite of products designed to help build next-generation interactive applications. This platform, leveraging Cloudflare’s global edge network, aims to improve connectivity for WebRTC-based video and audio applications, addressing challenges like latency, packet loss, jitter, and scaling to thousands of participants. The initiative recognizes the surge in demand for real-time communication, accelerated by recent global changes, and seeks to simplify the development and scaling of such applications.

title: Zoom, Five9 to terminate nearly $15 bln all-stock deal after shareholder vote
summary: Five9 shareholders voted against the $14.7 billion all-stock acquisition by Zoom Video Communications Inc., leading to the termination of the deal. Proxy advisory firms had recommended against the merger due to concerns about growth and Zoom's stock performance. Five9 will continue as a standalone public company, while Zoom plans to launch its own cloud-based contact center solution in early 2022.

title: Apple, Amazon, Microsoft, Disney Among Major Corporations Lying About Supporting Climate Action
summary: A new analysis by watchdog group Accountable.US reveals that major corporations like Apple, Amazon, Microsoft, and Disney are funding lobbying groups that actively work against significant climate legislation, despite publicly claiming to support climate action. These companies are reportedly supporting or directing organizations such as the U.S. Chamber of Commerce and Business Roundtable in their efforts to defeat the $3.5 trillion Build Back Better Act. This behavior is labeled as "greenwashing," where companies project an environmentally responsible image while undermining climate initiatives behind the scenes.

title: How Whirlpool turned the tide to find the right people
summary: Whirlpool faced a significant recruiting challenge, dealing with 200 applications per job and needing a more efficient and effective way to identify high-quality candidates who also fit the company's customer-centric values. By partnering with Plum, a talent management solution provider, Whirlpool implemented a three-step assessment process focusing on problem-solving and personality traits rather than traditional skills, which helped them better gauge candidate potential and improve hiring outcomes for interns and full-time roles despite initial skepticism from their recruitment team. The use of this assessment tool has also streamlined the recruitment workload and can aid in internal mobility.

title: GINN's Got the Goods of Quality Disruptive Companies
summary: The article highlights the Goldman Sachs Innovate Equity ETF (GINN) as a strong investment opportunity, particularly for those seeking exposure to high-quality, disruptive growth companies. Despite the S&P 500 Technology Index's flat performance in the third quarter, GINN focuses on larger, mature yet innovative companies with high return on equity (ROE), such as Nvidia, Apple, and Microsoft. The fund's significant allocation to technology and healthcare sectors, combined with its emphasis on quality traits and R&D-focused companies, positions it well for continued upside.

title: U.S. Supreme Court rebuffs Oracle challenge to Pentagon cloud contract
summary: The U.S. Supreme Court declined to hear Oracle Corp's challenge to the Pentagon's now-canceled $10 billion JEDI cloud computing contract. A lower court had ruled that Oracle was not harmed by any errors in the contract award process as the company would not have qualified. The JEDI contract, initially awarded to Microsoft Corp and later scrapped, is being replaced by a new contract expected to include Amazon.com.

title: Amdocs and Telkom Give Local Schools a Big Boost
summary: Amdocs and Telkom Foundation have partnered to provide South African schools in disadvantaged communities with internet data, tablets, food parcels, and COVID-19 relief items. This initiative aims to combat learning disruption caused by the pandemic and promote digital inclusion for students who lack access to necessary resources. The collaboration seeks to ensure continued education and provide humanitarian aid to hard-hit families.

title: EFG Hermes partners with Microsoft to accelerate its digital transformation – Middle East & Africa News Center
summary: EFG Hermes has partnered with Microsoft to accelerate its digital transformation, aiming to modernize its IT environment and completely digitize operations. This strategic cloud collaboration will enhance client, employee, and developer experiences, improve business agility, and drive innovation within the financial services industry. The partnership will establish a secure, flexible, and scalable platform to support EFG Hermes' continued growth and customer-centric approach in Frontier Emerging Markets.

title: ServiceNow expands partnership with Microsoft
summary: ServiceNow has expanded its strategic partnership with Microsoft, introducing a new collaborative app for its Employee Centre that integrates with Microsoft Teams. This integration aims to streamline employee experiences in hybrid work environments by providing a unified portal for accessing information and services directly within Teams. The collaboration focuses on improving productivity and engagement through enhanced digital workflows and shared go-to-market efforts.

title: Informatica Named a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader—For The 14th Time
summary: Informatica has been recognized as a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Data Quality Solutions for the 14th consecutive time. The article emphasizes the growing importance of data quality in technology, especially for AI initiatives, and highlights Informatica's consistent innovation, integrated end-to-end solutions, and cloud offerings as key strengths. It also cites customer success stories to demonstrate the value data quality brings to various organizations.

title: Integra LifeSciences enhances multicloud capability with OCI, achieves 90% time savings and boosts IT efficiency
summary: Integra LifeSciences significantly improved its IT efficiency and multicloud capabilities by migrating its mission-critical E-Business Suite applications to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). This move resulted in a 90% time savings for daily sales invoice reports and a reduction of nightly data analytics processing from 8.5 to 3.5 hours, leveraging OCI's high-performance platform and its interconnection with Microsoft Azure. The company also enhanced business resiliency and gained proactive performance insights, solidifying a strategic position for future growth.

title: GM aims to build Netflix-sized subscription business by 2030
summary: General Motors announced its ambitious goal to generate $25 billion in annual revenue from in-car subscription services by 2030, putting it in the same league as Netflix. The automaker expects nearly $2 billion in revenue from these services this year, driven by its current base of 4.2 million subscribed vehicles and the upcoming Ultifi software platform. GM plans to monetize features like OnStar, Maps+, and fleet management solutions, projecting a serviceable addressable market of $80 billion by 2030.

title: Roughly half of the Nasdaq 100 is below this critical longer-term trend line. Here's what's next
summary: A recent sell-off in high-growth stocks has caused roughly half of the Nasdaq 100 stocks to trade below their 200-day moving average, a critical longer-term trend line. This comes as bond yields rise due to higher inflation expectations, making valuations of growth stocks harder to justify. While some strategists believe tech might lag as the economy reopens, others anticipate a rotation back into growth stocks after the recent decline.

title: VISA to Join Microsoft & Google in Atlanta’s Hottest Office Submarket
summary: VISA has leased 123,000 square feet in Midtown Atlanta for a new hub, expecting to create 1,000 jobs, joining other tech giants like Microsoft and Google which have also established significant presences in the city. Atlanta's thriving tech scene, bolstered by strong local talent and a supportive ecosystem, continues to attract major companies and foster homegrown successes. This influx of tech firms is transforming Atlanta into a key hub for innovation and employment in the tech sector.

title: BNPL stocks are getting pantsed — will the sector crack?
summary: High-growth tech stocks, particularly those in the Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) sector, have experienced significant pressure in recent weeks due to hints of tightening financial conditions as the world emerges from the pandemic. Many BNPL companies saw monthly falls of over 10%, with some like Sezzle experiencing a 20% drop. While larger players like Afterpay and Zip Co are affected, an expert suggests that consolidation among smaller BNPL firms is more likely than major takeovers.

title: Discover Equal Weight Benefits With RSP
summary: This article discusses the benefits of equal weight ETFs, using the Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF (RSP) as a prime example. It explains how equal weighting offers diversification beyond cap-weighted funds and benefits from mean-reversion, despite critics associating its outperformance with size and value factors. The article highlights RSP's long-term outperformance potential and its role in true diversification by preventing a few mega-cap stocks from dominating the index.

title: SilverTerrier – Nigerian Business Email Compromise
summary: Business email compromise (BEC) remains a prevalent and costly cyber threat, with global losses exceeding $1.8 billion in 2020. This article details the evolution of Nigerian BEC actors, tracked as "SilverTerrier" by Palo Alto Networks Unit 42, highlighting their changing tactics, malware trends, and the efforts taken by law enforcement and the cybersecurity community to combat these schemes. It also provides recommendations for organizations to protect themselves against BEC threats.

title: Teams vs. Webex vs. Zoom: Comparing collaboration features
summary: This article compares the collaboration features of Microsoft Teams, Webex by Cisco, and Zoom, addressing how each platform supports hybrid meetings, security controls, and contact center integrations. It highlights their differing approaches to features like intelligent framing, content storage, and event management, guiding organizations in choosing the best UCaaS platform for their post-pandemic remote and hybrid work needs.

title: Infographic: Why Are You Wasting Your SaaS Expenditure?
summary: Gartner's analysis projects a 19% growth in annual SaaS expenditure, yet identifies that a quarter of this software will be underutilized or over-deployed. The article suggests that executive leaders can mitigate this waste by mandating the use of software asset management functions. This infographic highlights the inefficiencies in SaaS spending and offers a solution to improve cost-effectiveness.

title: EXCLUSIVE US electronics firm struck deal to transport and hire Uyghur workers
summary: Universal Electronics Inc (UEIC.O), a U.S. remote-control maker, confirmed entering an agreement with Xinjiang authorities to transport and employ hundreds of Uyghur workers at its plant in Qinzhou, China. This marks the first confirmed instance of an American company participating in a worker-transfer program described by some rights groups as forced labor. The article details the conditions of these workers, including police escorts, segregated living quarters, and mandatory "education activities," raising concerns among human rights organizations and prompting responses from UEI's business partners like Sony and Microsoft.

title: Paul Marshall and Ian Wace’s Stock Picks: Biogen Inc (BIIB), Apple Inc (AAPL) and More
summary: This article details the top stock picks of hedge fund managers Paul Marshall and Ian Wace, based on their Q2 2021 holdings. It highlights a selection of companies including Biogen Inc (BIIB), Apple Inc (AAPL), Zoetis Inc. (ZTS), ViacomCBS Inc. (VIAC), and Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. (TMO), providing details on their stake value, company background, and recent analyst ratings or news. The piece also explains the investment philosophy and background of Marshall Wace LLP.

title: In Atlanta's Grove Park, Microsoft Corp. will try to succeed where Big Tech often fails - Atlanta Business Chronicle
summary: Microsoft Corp. is establishing a 15,000-job campus in Atlanta's Grove Park, a Black working-class neighborhood characterized by significant income inequality and poverty. This move presents a challenge for Microsoft to avoid the pitfalls of gentrification often associated with Big Tech expansions in historically underserved communities. The article implies that Microsoft aims to make a positive impact, addressing the complexities of revitalization in an area with a low average disposable income.

title: More U.S. stock-market giants become available to Canadians in a low-cost version. Plus, why some investors may be underestimating the bull case for equities
summary: Canadian investors can now access fractional shares of major U.S. companies through Canadian depositary receipts (CDRs) offered by CIBC, providing a low-cost, currency-hedged investment option. These CDRs have seen strong interest, especially from DIY investors, despite slightly wider bid-ask spreads compared to their U.S. counterparts. The article also discusses reasons why investors might be underestimating the current bull case for equities, despite recent market wobbles due to inflation, bond yields, and other global concerns.

title: Qualcomm Dual Station Wi-Fi 6E Tech Brings Wired Ping Times To Windows 11 Gamers
summary: Qualcomm has partnered with Microsoft to bring Wi-Fi Dual Station technology to Windows 11, utilizing Qualcomm's FastConnect hardware to enable wired-like ping times for gamers over Wi-Fi. This technology leverages multiple Wi-Fi bands (2.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz) simultaneously to reduce latency and packet loss. Valve is integrating support for this feature into its Steamworks SDK, ensuring popular titles like Dota 2 and Counter-Strike: Global Offensive can benefit from this enhanced wireless gaming experience.

title: Examining both sides of the AI regulation debate
summary: This article explores the ongoing debate surrounding AI regulation, highlighting the perspectives of both proponents and opponents. Some leaders advocate for regulations to prevent discrimination and harm, while others express concern that excessive rules could hinder innovation. The discussion covers the potential benefits and drawbacks of AI regulation, referencing opinions from government officials and industry experts.

title: Microsoft named as a Leader in 2021 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Enterprise Integration Platform as a Service
summary: Microsoft has been recognized as a Leader in the 2021 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Enterprise Integration Platform as a Service (EiPaaS) for the fourth consecutive year. Their Azure Integration Services (AIS), including Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, and Data Factory, enable customers to connect applications, data, and services across various environments. AIS emphasizes empowering diverse user personas, offering flexible pricing, and strong customer momentum across various industries for modern integration solutions.

title: Microsoft Philippines Appoints New Small & Medium Corporate Director
summary: Microsoft Philippines has appointed Ms. Elizabeth Pangan as the new Director for its Small and Medium Corporate (SMC) segment. Pangan brings over 30 years of experience in cloud, IT, and enterprise industries, with previous roles at Microsoft and leadership positions elsewhere. Her return is expected to significantly contribute to Microsoft's mission and digital transformation efforts for customers in the Philippines.

title: Highest Density SuperBlade® Server for HPC Applications
summary: Supermicro's SuperBlade® server solutions offer high density and efficiency for HPC, enterprise cloud, and other demanding applications. Available in 8U, 6U, and 4U enclosures, these systems support advanced processors from Intel and AMD, high-speed networking, and various storage options, alongside resource-saving architecture for optimal TCO. The article highlights successful deployments by companies like HEROZ and Korea Hydro and Nuclear Power, and provides extensive details on features and configurations.

title: ePLDT unveils cloud-based phone system service for MS Teams
