title: Microsoft’s shift to the cloud is a lesson in corporate evolution
summary: This article details Microsoft's successful transition to cloud computing, highlighting the internal and external challenges faced and overcome. It examines how the company, under both Steve Ballmer and later Satya Nadella, navigated customer skepticism and internal resistance to redefine its business model. The narrative emphasizes the importance of anticipating market shifts and making bold strategic decisions even when ahead of current customer demand.

title: Cisco and SONiC
summary: Cisco is actively supporting SONiC, an open-source operating system for cloud-scale data center networks, by integrating it with their Cisco 8000 series routing platforms. This commitment allows hyperscalers to leverage open capabilities and advanced hardware platforms for their network architectures. Cisco demonstrated their SONiC integration at the 2021 OCP Global Summit and also collaborated with Meta on the Wedge400C data center switch, highlighting their versatile offerings for various customer needs.

title: 85% of organizations will be "cloud-first" by 2025, says Gartner
summary: Gartner predicts that over 85% of organizations will adopt a "cloud-first" strategy by 2025, with 95% of new digital workloads moving to cloud-native platforms. This shift, accelerated by the pandemic, also signifies a rapid growth in low/no-code application development and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) technologies. IT professionals are advised to adapt by acquiring new skills in areas like automation, AI, and cloud-native development.

title: Wells Fargo lays foundation for public cloud transformation
summary: Wells Fargo is embarking on an ambitious 10-year journey to overhaul its operations by adopting a hybrid private and public multicloud architecture, primarily leveraging Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform. The financial institution plans to begin deploying applications to the public cloud in early 2022, emphasizing security due to the sensitive nature of financial data. This transformation involves re-engineering applications for the cloud rather than simply "lift and shifting" existing ones, with a significant focus on upskilling its workforce to manage the new cloud-centric environment.

title: Bullet Hell RPG Archvale Will Be Released Next Month
summary: The hybrid RPG and bullet hell shooter, Archvale, is set to launch on December 2 for Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and PC, including availability on Xbox Game Pass. A PC demo will be accessible starting November 13 via the Humble Store. The game emphasizes skill-based bullet hell combat alongside traditional RPG crafting and character customization.

title: Accelerating the transition
summary: This article summarizes a fireside chat with Satya Nadella (CEO, Microsoft) and Lorenzo Simonelli (Chairman and CEO, Baker Hughes) at the Annual Meeting 2021. Nadella discusses the digital transformation of industries, the excitement around new technology frontiers like elastic computing and distributed computing, and Microsoft's sustainability commitments. He also shares his views on the future of work, emphasizing hybrid models and employee well-being post-pandemic.

title: Former Federal CIO Tony Scott Named President, CEO of Cyber Firm Intrusion
summary: Tony Scott, former federal chief information officer during the Obama administration, has been appointed president and CEO of cybersecurity company Intrusion, effective Monday. Scott previously led The TonyScottGroup, a consulting firm he established in 2017 to manage cybersecurity posture for clients. His career also includes CIO roles at VMware and Microsoft, and CTO at General Motors, as well as overseeing the government's $85 billion annual IT budget as federal CIO.

title: Kyndryl and Microsoft Establish Global Strategic Partnership to Accelerate Digital Transformation Across Industries
summary: Kyndryl and Microsoft have formed a global strategic partnership, making Microsoft Kyndryl's first Premier Global Alliance Partner since Kyndryl's independence. This collaboration aims to accelerate digital transformation for enterprise customers by leveraging the Microsoft Cloud, focusing on hybrid cloud adoption, application modernization, and critical workload support. The partnership is expected to create multi-billion dollar revenue opportunities for both companies and includes the establishment of a co-innovation lab and a "Kyndryl University for Microsoft" to enhance technical skills.

title: OALC ETF Profile: Dividends, Returns (BOATS:OALC)
summary: This article provides a detailed profile of the OneAscent Large Cap Core ETF (OALC), highlighting its investment strategy, holdings, and financial performance. OALC actively invests in US large-cap stocks, utilizing values-based screening and fundamental analysis, with a particular focus on corporate and social responsibility. title: Human Capital Management Market Size to Reach USD 32.84 Billion in 2028 | Rising Usage of Cloud Services and Increasing Government Initiatives to Bolster Digitization are Key Factors Driving HCM Market Revenue Growth
summary: The Human Capital Management (HCM) market is projected to reach USD 32.84 billion by 2028, growing from USD 18.04 billion in 2020 at a CAGR of 7.9%. This growth is primarily driven by the increasing adoption of cloud services, advanced HR technologies, and government initiatives promoting digitization. Despite data security concerns, the integration of AI and ML into HCM solutions is further boosting market expansion, particularly in the Asia Pacific region.

title: Data storytelling company Narrative Science will join Tableau via Salesforce acquisition
summary: Narrative Science, a Chicago-based data storytelling company known for its Lexio software, will be acquired by Salesforce and integrated into Tableau Software. This move aims to expand Tableau's offerings through language-centric mediums like Slack and help more people understand and act on data. Narrative Science, founded in 2010, has raised $43 million in funding and has employees in Seattle, Chicago, and New York.

title: Unity launches ‘metaverse’ platforms to simulate robot deployments
summary: Unity has introduced two new products, Unity Simulation Pro and Unity SystemGraph, designed to simulate AI and robotics deployments for virtual testing and analysis. These platforms allow engineers to emulate robotics systems and sensors, and test them at accelerated rates, significantly reducing costs and development time. The move aligns with Unity's pivot from video game engines to enterprise 3D tools and an "industrial metaverse" concept, with real-world applications shown by collaborations with the Allen Institute of AI, Carnegie Mellon University, and Volvo.

title: IonQ Announces Third Quarter 2021 Financial Results
summary: IonQ announced its third-quarter 2021 financial results, highlighting total contract value (TCV) bookings of $15.1 million year-to-date and updated its 2021 TCV bookings guidance to $15.8 million at the midpoint. The company also reported significant technological milestones, including industry-first error correction demonstration and superior quantum computer performance, alongside strategic collaborations and a strong financial position after its business combination. Financial highlights included $223 thousand in revenue for the quarter, $587 million in cash and cash equivalents, and a net loss of $14.8 million.

summary: OpenText announced the release of Content Cloud CE 21.4, introducing new innovations aimed at enhancing modern work, providing contextual content access, and accelerating business processes with improved governance. Key updates include deeper integrations with applications like Salesforce and Microsoft Office 365, enhanced machine learning for data capture, and new industry-specific solutions. title: How to create security metrics business leaders care about
summary: Security leaders need to present metrics that clearly connect to business outcomes, provide appropriate context, match the message to the audience, report on alignment with targets, and build strong narratives. By following these five steps, security professionals can create metrics that are clear, actionable, and resonate with business leadership, leading to better and more informed security decisions for the enterprise. The goal is to move beyond mere numbers and empower business leaders to understand and act on security-related information.

title: Qualcomm, diversifying from mobile phones, to supply chips for BMW self-driving cars
summary: Qualcomm announced that it will supply chips for BMW's next generation of driver-assistance and self-driving systems, marking a significant diversification beyond its core mobile phone chip business. This move underscores Qualcomm's strategic expansion into the automotive sector, aiming to challenge competitors like Nvidia and Intel in the self-driving technology market. The new chips will be used in BMW's "Neue Klasse" series of cars, with production slated to begin in 2025.

title: Texas Instruments selects Sherman for potential $30 billion semiconductor chipmaking campus
summary: Texas Instruments announced plans to invest up to $30 billion to build as many as four new semiconductor fabrication plants in Sherman, Texas. The company plans to begin construction next year on the first two plants, with chip production estimated to start by 2025. This significant investment aims to strengthen TI's manufacturing capabilities and address the growing demand for semiconductors.

title: FBI Fake Hack Alert A ‘Tipping Point’ in Fight Against Cybercrime
summary: A recent fake alert distributed by the Department of Homeland Security, resulting from the sabotage of an FBI server, is being called a "tipping point" in the fight against cybercrime by Rep. Carolyn B. Maloney. This incident, alongside major ransomware attacks on CNA Financial, Colonial Pipeline, and JBS Foods, highlighted vulnerabilities and the challenges businesses face in responding to such attacks. The discussions took place during a House Oversight and Reform Committee hearing, coinciding with new cybersecurity funding included in a recently signed infrastructure package.

title: Iran-backed hackers exploiting Microsoft, Fortinet bugs
summary: Federal cyber agencies from the US, UK, and Australia have issued a joint warning about Iranian government-sponsored hackers exploiting vulnerabilities in Microsoft Exchange email servers and Fortinet products. These Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) groups are using these exploits to gain initial access to systems, deploy ransomware, and conduct data exfiltration in various critical infrastructure sectors. The advisory highlights that these activities have been ongoing since at least March 2021 for Fortinet vulnerabilities and October 2021 for Microsoft Exchange ProxyShell.

title: IIM Bangalore witnesses record summer placement season
summary: IIM Bangalore's PGP and PGP-BA Class of 2021-23 recorded a successful summer placement season with 542 internship offers, placing all 513 students. Consulting companies led with 181 offers, followed by strong recruitment in IT, e-commerce, finance, and general management roles. The placements signal a reviving economy and high demand for talent to manage post-pandemic markets.

title: Saviynt Enterprise Identity Cloud secures cloud assets for Microsoft customers
summary: Saviynt has released its 2021 Saviynt Enterprise Identity Cloud (EIC), enhancing security and compliance for Microsoft customers with privileged identity and session management via a new Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) PIM integration. This release aims to minimize access sprawl, reduce privilege risks, and simplify identity and access technologies by building on Azure AD and offering features like end-to-end PIM, Microsoft Teams integration for access approvals, and improved Active Directory support. Saviynt EIC 2021 is designed to eliminate the need for multiple identity management products and streamline identity governance.

title: NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) Q3 2021 Earnings Call Transcript
summary: NVIDIA reported an outstanding Q3 2021 with record revenue of $7.1 billion, up 50% year-on-year, driven by strong performance in Gaming, Data Center, and Professional Visualization. The company highlighted the expansion of its RTX technology in gaming and creative applications, the growing adoption of Omniverse for digital twins and AI avatars, and significant advancements in its Data Center business with AI inference and enterprise solutions. NVIDIA also addressed the status of its proposed acquisition of Arm and provided a positive outlook for future growth, particularly in the Data Center segment.

summary: This article details the pricing model for Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, which is built on Azure Blob Storage. summary: Rackspace Technology, a leader in multi-cloud services, helps customers design, build, and operate cloud environments. A global survey conducted with Google Cloud indicates rapid cloud adoption, with many organizations moving all applicable infrastructure to the cloud to leverage it for innovation and growth.

title: Health tech: The 15 next big things, from easier dialysis to AI ultrasounds
summary: Fast Company's first Next Big Things in Tech awards highlight 15 health tech innovations, ranging from easier dialysis solutions to AI-powered ultrasounds. These advancements address a spectrum of medical challenges, including blood pressure monitoring via smartphones, mapping plant chemical diversity for medicine, and using AI to predict patient outcomes and improve cardiac care. The article features winners such as Biospectal, Brightseed, Caption Health, ClosedLoop AI, Microsoft and Adaptive Biotechnologies, and Outset Medical.

title: How Constellation Brands built a better ordering system on AWS
Why Sabre is betting against multi-cloud
summary: Sabre, a travel technology company, has entered a 10-year, $2 billion partnership with Google Cloud, committing to a single cloud provider despite the prevailing multi-cloud trend among large enterprises. CIO Joe DiFonzo explains that an initial multi-cloud exploration led them to realize the inefficiencies of managing disparate architectures and the benefits of leveraging a single vendor's full capabilities and engineering mindset. This decision allows Sabre to focus on modernizing operations, decomposing applications into microservices, and integrating AI-powered services by leaning on Google's extensive technological advancements.

title: Pentagon asks Amazon, Google, Microsoft and Oracle for bids on new cloud contracts
summary: The Pentagon has requested bids from Amazon, Google, Microsoft, and Oracle for new cloud contracts, moving away from a single-vendor approach. This initiative, known as Joint Warfighting Cloud Capability (JWCC), follows the cancellation of the highly contested JEDI contract previously awarded to Microsoft. While Amazon and Microsoft are expected to be primary awardees, the contracts aim to include other capable cloud service providers to support the Pentagon's diverse cloud computing needs.

title: Stanley Druckenmiller is Selling These 5 Stocks
summary: Billionaire Stanley Druckenmiller is reducing his stakes in several companies, including a significant decrease in his holdings of Intuit Inc. During the third quarter of 2021, Druckenmiller's hedge fund decreased its shares in Intuit by 51%, though it still held over $47 million worth of the company's stock. Intuit recently reported strong first fiscal quarter earnings, beating estimates with $1.53 EPS and a 52% year-over-year revenue increase to $2 billion.

title: Microsoft partners with Caterpillar and Ballard to test megawatt-scale hydrogen fuel cell backup generator
summary: Microsoft is collaborating with Caterpillar and Ballard Power Systems to test a 1.5 MW hydrogen fuel cell backup generator at its Quincy, Washington data center. This three-year project, partially funded by the US Department of Energy, aims to provide uninterruptible power with high uptime and explore the scalability and 48-hour operation capabilities of hydrogen fuel cells. The initiative is part of Microsoft's broader commitment to eliminate diesel fuel dependency by 2030 and achieve carbon negative status.

title: Starbucks EMEA Transforms Technology Management and Maximizes Customer Satisfaction with NCR Partnership
summary: Starbucks EMEA partnered with NCR Corporation to streamline technology management and enhance customer satisfaction across its 43 markets. NCR's Digital Connected Services provide a single point of contact for software, hardware, and services, offering real-time monitoring and issue resolution to ensure smooth store operations 24/7. This collaboration has improved operational support, lowered costs, and optimized efficiency, allowing Starbucks employees to focus on delivering a great customer experience.

title: Ballard teams up with Caterpillar & Microsoft to demonstrate megawatt-scale hydrogen fuel cell backup generator system for datacenters
summary: Ballard Power Systems, in collaboration with Caterpillar Inc. and Microsoft, has launched a three-year project to demonstrate a megawatt-scale hydrogen fuel cell backup generator system for data centers. This initiative, supported by the U.S. Department of Energy, aims to develop a 1.5 MW backup power system with significantly reduced emissions compared to current diesel systems. The project will provide insights into scaling fuel cell technology for multi-megawatt data centers, leveraging low-carbon-intensity hydrogen.

title: Ballard, Caterpillar And Microsoft To Produce Back-up Power For Data Centres
summary: Ballard Power Systems, Caterpillar Inc., and Microsoft have launched a three-year collaboration to demonstrate a 1.5 MW hydrogen fuel cell power system for data center backup. This project, supported by the U.S. Department of Energy and the National Renewable Energy Lab, aims to provide reliable, sustainable backup power with significantly reduced emissions. The demonstration will take place at a Microsoft data center in Quincy, Washington.

title: Observing Attacks Against Hundreds of Exposed Services in Public Clouds
summary: Unit 42 researchers deployed a global honeypot infrastructure of 320 nodes to study attacks against exposed services in public clouds. They found that 80% of honeypots were compromised within 24 hours and all within a week, highlighting the rapid pace at which attackers exploit misconfigured services. The research emphasizes the ineffectiveness of IP-based firewalls and the critical need for quick vulnerability remediation in cloud environments.

title: Digital Realty Launches $977m Core Data Center REIT via Singapore IPO
summary: Digital Realty (NYSE: DLR) is launching Digital Core REIT, a new Singapore REIT, through an initial public offering (IPO) on the Singapore Exchange (SGX) to raise $977 million. The REIT will acquire and operate a portfolio of 10 fully leased data centers in the U.S. and Canada, primarily serving major cloud and IT providers like Microsoft, Facebook, and Amazon Web Services. Digital Realty will retain a significant ownership stake in the new REIT, which aims for an annual total return of 10.01% for unitholders.

title: Hershey Re-Opens the Global Customer Insights Center, Designed for Virtual and In-Person Collaboration
summary: Hershey has re-opened its renovated Global Customer Insights Center (GCIC) in October, enabling virtual and in-person collaboration with retail partners. The center, closed since March 2020, allows Hershey to share unique shopper insights and develop strategic growth initiatives. New features include "micro" seasonal solutions, displays for alternative fulfillment experiences, small format store insights, and expanded food service options.

title: Samsung, Hynix notch best day this year; metaverse to drive chip demand
summary: Shares of Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, South Korea's largest chipmakers, experienced their biggest single-day gains this year amid an improving outlook for the memory chip industry. Analysts suggest the current downturn in the memory market could be shorter than expected, driven by the emerging demand from the metaverse. Foreign investors, who had been selling off shares due to pessimistic views, are now returning, further bolstering the stock performance.

title: Zoom vs Microsoft Teams vs Google Meet: What's the best video conferencing service?
summary: This article compares Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet, three leading video conferencing services, to help users choose the best option based on their needs. It details the features, supported devices, and pricing for each platform, highlighting their strengths for personal, small group, and enterprise use. The author recommends Zoom as the overall best choice due to its ease of use, superior screen sharing, and better control for larger groups.

title: Apple files lawsuit against NSO Group, saying U.S. citizens were targets
summary: Apple has filed a lawsuit against Israeli cyber firm NSO Group and its parent company OSY Technologies, alleging surveillance and targeting of U.S. Apple users with its Pegasus spyware. The iPhone maker is seeking to ban NSO Group from using any Apple software, services, or devices and will donate $10 million, plus any damages, to cybersurveillance research groups. NSO maintains that its tools are sold only to governments and law enforcement and have saved "thousands of lives."

title: Four Ways to Reduce Security Risks Using Software Updates and Deployment Resources
summary: This article outlines four key strategies for organizations to enhance their cybersecurity posture by effectively managing software updates and deployments. It emphasizes the importance of subscribing to security notifications, promptly installing updates, utilizing enterprise deployment tools, and replacing unsupported software. The guidance aligns with CISA's directive on reducing known exploited vulnerabilities and highlights Adobe's resources and support for these initiatives.

title: Beyond Qubits: Cryogenic Chip Is Big Step To Scale Up Quantum Computing
summary: Scientists from the University of Sydney and Microsoft Corporation have developed a cryogenic chip that can generate control signals for thousands of qubits, addressing a major bottleneck in scaling up quantum computers. This innovative device operates at extremely low temperatures (0.1 Kelvin) and integrates the control system directly with the qubits, eliminating the need for extensive wiring and significantly improving efficiency. The collaboration highlights the engineering challenges and advancements required to build practical quantum machines, pushing quantum computing beyond its current limited qubit count.

title: The Internet is Held Together With Spit & Baling Wire
summary: This article discusses a significant security vulnerability in how Internet Routing Registries (IRRs) have historically authenticated updates, specifically the insecure "MAIL-FROM" method. Lumen Technologies (formerly CenturyLink), a major Internet backbone provider, recently disabled this method after a security researcher demonstrated how it could be exploited to hijack Internet traffic for large companies. The article highlights the fragile nature of the Internet's underlying infrastructure and ongoing challenges in routing security despite newer, more secure technologies like RPKI.

title: Fortinet announces 1st next-gen Firewall & Secure SD-WAN Integration with Microsoft Azure Virtual WAN
summary: Fortinet has announced an expanded collaboration with Microsoft to integrate its next-generation firewall (NGFW) and Secure SD-WAN with Microsoft Azure Virtual WAN. This marks the industry's first such integration, allowing customers to apply advanced security policies to virtual WAN traffic and extend Secure SD-WAN into the Azure virtual WAN hub. The partnership aims to simplify, automate, and secure cloud on-ramps and SD-WAN experiences for enterprises.

title: Fortinet collaborates with Microsoft Azure to offer industry’s first next-generation firewall
summary: Fortinet has announced an expanded collaboration with Microsoft to introduce the industry's first next-generation firewall (NGFW) and Secure SD-WAN integration with Microsoft Azure Virtual WAN. This allows customers to apply advanced security policies to virtual WAN traffic and extend Secure SD-WAN into the Azure virtual WAN hub, combining advanced security and networking in the cloud. The integration aims to simplify and secure cloud on-ramping and SD-WAN experiences for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments.

title: UK fintech Thought Machine surpasses $1B valuation
summary: London-based fintech, Thought Machine, has achieved a valuation surpassing $1 billion after a successful $200 million Series C funding round. The company, founded by a former Google engineer, specializes in helping banks transition from traditional legacy systems to cloud-based platforms, with its flagship product being the cloud-native core banking platform, Vault. This recent funding will be used to further develop Vault, particularly its Universal Product Engine, and accelerate its deployment to banks globally.

title: Microsoft is Equipping People with Low-Code AI
summary: Microsoft is empowering "citizen developers" with low-code AI solutions, exemplified by its Azure AI Platform and Project Bonsai. These tools enable businesses to integrate advanced AI capabilities without extensive data science expertise, as demonstrated by PepsiCo's successful implementation of Project Bonsai to improve Cheetos production consistency. The initiative aims to make AI more accessible and practical for everyday business applications.

title: CIBC recruits Danske Bank’s Søren Rode Jain Andreasen for digital leadership role
summary: Søren Rode Jain Andreasen is leaving Danske Bank after 15 years to join Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC) as Enterprise Digital and Innovation Officer. In his new role, Andreasen will focus on CIBC's digital client experience, managing digital budgets, channels, AI, automation investments, and partnerships. His hire aligns with CIBC's "cloud-first approach" following a multi-year agreement with Microsoft Azure.

summary: This article highlights seven prominent Indian American CEOs leading major US corporations, whose combined revenue in 2020 exceeded $530 billion. title: Bret Taylor appointed co-CEO of Salesforce as shares drop on lower-than-expected forcecast
summary: Bret Taylor has been appointed co-chief executive officer of Salesforce Inc. Despite better-than-expected Q3 results of $1.27 a share profit and $6.86 billion in revenue, investors reacted negatively to Q4 guidance that projected lower profits than analysts anticipated.

title: How a Stanford couple created Taiwan’s best-known AI start-up
summary: This article details how a Stanford couple, Chih-Han Yu and Winnie Lee, founded Appier, Taiwan's first AI unicorn. title: Autodesk Revit now supports Microsoft Windows 11
summary: Autodesk has announced that Revit and Revit LT versions 2019 through 2024 now support Microsoft Windows 11. This support comes after extensive testing, ensuring the software runs smoothly on the new operating system. summary: The article discusses the fading hyper-concentration of stock market returns from a handful of large technology stocks, particularly the FAANGs, in 2021 compared to 2020. While large stocks still contribute significantly, their overall impact on market returns has decreased, resembling a more traditional market distribution.

summary: This article identifies six top Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) for investors seeking growth in 2021. summary: CVS Health and Microsoft Corp. announced a five-year partnership to personalize care for CVS's over 100 million customers, utilizing Microsoft's technology and cloud services. The collaboration aims to accelerate CVS's digital transformation, deliver customized health recommendations, improve medication adherence, and enhance operational efficiency for front-line workers. Financial terms were not disclosed, but the initiative focuses on leveraging data and technology to improve customer experience and care delivery.

summary: The Invesco QQQ Trust Series 1 ETF, which tracks the Nasdaq 100, is a tech-heavy fund that experienced a nosedive following the omicron variant news and inflation concerns in December 2021. summary: Chipotle has released a Cilantro Soap through its Chipotle Goods website, capitalizing on a popular meme about cilantro tasting like soap for a segment of the population. This initiative, alongside a partnership with Halo Infinite Multiplayer, demonstrates Chipotle's strategy to engage with culture and attract younger, digitally-native audiences through branded merchandise and gaming activations. The brand's CMO, Chris Brandt, noted that the Cilantro Soap is an example of "turning digital moments into real life experiences."

summary: Microsoft has updated its Service Level Agreements (SLA) for Online Services, specifically increasing the uptime guarantee for Calling Plans, Phone System, and Audio Conferencing within Microsoft Teams from 99.9% to 99.99%.
